data.description:
Softwareentwickler (m/w/d)

Festanstellung, Vollzeit | Raum Regensburg (Hybrides Arbeiten)

Über Everfield

Everfield ist auf den Erwerb, die Entwicklung und den Ausbau von europäischen Software-Unternehmen in unterschiedlichen Märkten spezialisiert. Wir stellen unseren Unternehmen jegliche strategischen Ressourcen zur Verfügung, die sie benötigen, um auf die nächste Wachstumsstufe zu gelangen. Unsere Mission ist es, ambitionierte Visionen zu verwirklichen, nachhaltiges Wachstum zu fördern und neue Chancen im europäischen Software-Ökosystem zu erschließen.

Die Unternehmen im Everfield-Ökosystem bewahren ihre Teams, Marken und Standorte, um sich gezielt auf ihre Kernkompetenzen zu konzentrieren: die Entwicklung innovativer Produkte und die umfassende Betreuung ihrer Kunden. Everfield bietet dabei gezielte Unterstützung in den Bereichen Personalgewinnung und HR sowie Zugang zu einem Expertenteam, das auf den Aufbau und das Wachstum europäischer B2B-SaaS-Unternehmen spezialisiert ist und in finanziellen sowie operativen Belangen berät. Seit der Gründung im Jahr 2022 ist Everfield in 7 Ländern präsent – und wächst stetig weiter.

Über uns

ondeso ist ein führender Anbieter von OT-Administrationssoftware für die industrielle IT mit Sitz in Regensburg: Mit ondeso SR bieten wir Industrie-PCs eine zuverlässige, standardmäßig integrierte Backup-Lösung für Sicherungen ganz ohne Neustart oder Produktionsunterbrechung. Zur Verstärkung unseres Entwicklungsteams suchen wir einen erfahrenen C-Entwickler (m/w/d), der diese Kerntechnologie systemnah und performancekritisch weiterentwickelt.

Deine Aufgaben:

· Weiterentwicklung und Wartung unseres Produktportfolios

· Einarbeitung in bestehenden Code sowie Analyse und Behebung von Fehlern

· Sicherstellung von Stabilität und Datenintegrität bei laufenden/produktiven Systemen

· Weiterentwicklung sicherheitsrelevanter Komponenten (u. a. Verschlüsselung)

· Entwicklung mit KI-Unterstützung (wir arbeiten in der Entwicklung mit Claude)

· Enge Zusammenarbeit im Entwicklerteam, auch bei Architekturentscheidungen für unsere Storage- und Backup-Lösung und unsere anderen Produkte

· Eigenverantwortliche Qualitätssicherung und Testen der eigenen Entwicklungen

Dein Profil:

· Mehrjährige Erfahrung in der Softwareentwicklung

· Offenheit für KI-gestützte Entwicklung

· Selbstständige, sorgfältige Arbeitsweise – bei unseren Produkten ist Datenintegrität entscheidend

· Kommunikationsstärke und Freude an der Arbeit im kleinen Team

· Fließende Deutschkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift sowie gute Englischkenntnisse

Nice-to-have:

· Praktische Erfahrung mit KI-gestützter Programmierung (z. B. mit Claude)

· Kenntnisse in C-Programmierung und/oder C++ oder C#

· Windows-Low-Level-Programmierung, z. B. Kernel, Treiber (WDK) oder Dateisysteme

· Know-how in Storage- oder Backup-Software

· Vertrautheit mit industriellen OT-Umgebungen oder Industrie-PCs

· Grundkenntnisse in Linux und Cloud-Umgebungen (z. B. Azure, AWS)

Was wir bieten:

· Hybrides Arbeiten: zwei Tage pro Woche im Büro in Regensburg, die übrigen Tage im Homeoffice

· Flexible Arbeitszeiten durch Gleitzeit

· Persönliches Onboarding-Programm mit gezielter fachlicher Unterstützung

· Flache Hierarchien und kurze Entscheidungswege

· Hohe Eigenverantwortung und direkter Einfluss auf die Weiterentwicklung unserer Kerntechnologie

Bewerbungsprozess & Kontakt:

Passt dieses Profil zu dir? Dann freuen wir uns auf deine Bewerbung!

Ablauf: In einem ersten, kurzen Screening-Gespräch (ca. 30 Minuten) lernst du unseren Talent Acquisition Lead Karolina kennen. Im zweiten Schritt führst du ein vertiefendes Gespräch mit Kathrin (ondeso HR) und Martin (ondeso CTO) (ca. 45 Minuten).

data.title: (Junior) Accountant (m/w/d)
data.description:
Über Holidu

Holidu ist eines der am schnellsten wachsenden Tech-Unternehmen für Ferienvermietung weltweit. Unser Ziel: Ferienunterkünfte sollen sich sorgenfrei buchen und vermieten lassen und dabei einfach Freude machen. Dafür helfen wir Gastgeber*innen, mit weniger Aufwand mehr Buchungen zu erzielen, und Gästen, genau die Ferienunterkunft zu finden, in der sie sich rundum wohlfühlen. Bei uns arbeiten rund 700 Kolleg*innen aus über 60 Nationen. Uns verbinden die Leidenschaft für Technologie, der Anspruch, jeden Tag ein Stück besser zu werden, und der Antrieb, mehr als 40.000 Gastgeber*innen und 4 Millionen Gästen im Jahr das bestmögliche Erlebnis zu bieten.

Dein Team

Unser Finance-Team kümmert sich um die Zahlen hinter der schnell wachsenden Reiseplattform. In der Buchhaltung sind wir rund 15 Kolleg*innen und verantworten aktuell mehr als zehn Gesellschaften im In- und Ausland, Tendenz steigend. Bei uns lernst du das Handwerk der Buchhaltung von erfahrenen Kolleg*innen von Grund auf und übernimmst Schritt für Schritt mehr Verantwortung; in welche Richtung, das gestaltest du mit deinen Stärken und Interessen. Weil wir wirklich als Team arbeiten, kommt der Spaß dabei nicht zu kurz, im Alltag wie bei unseren Teamevents.

Deine Aufgaben

  • Du übernimmst Aufgaben der Finanzbuchhaltung, insbesondere in der Kreditorenbuchhaltung im operativen Tagesgeschäft: du bearbeitest unser Buchhaltungspostfach, erfasst und verbuchst Rechnungen, bereitest Zahlläufe vor, unterstützt bei der laufenden Kontenabstimmung und -pflege und klärst kleinere Differenzen zunehmend selbstständig.

  • Du wirkst bei unseren Monats- und Jahresabschlüssen mit.

  • Du unterstützt bei Projekten zum Beispiel bei der Prozessoptimierung in der Buchhaltung

  • Du hilfst mit, unsere Buchhaltung Schritt für Schritt schlauer zu machen, zum Beispiel mit Excel oder KI.

  • Du entwickelst dich Schritt für Schritt weiter und gestaltest deine Zukunft bei uns aktiv mit.

 

Dein Profil

  • Du hast eine abgeschlossene kaufmännische Ausbildung, z. B. als Steuerfachangestellte*r, oder ein betriebswirtschaftliches Studium mit Schwerpunkt Finanzbuchhaltung / Rechnungswesen.

  • Du hast bereits erste Berufserfahrung in der Buchhaltung gesammelt, zum Beispiel im Rahmen deiner Ausbildung, eines Praktikums oder einer Werkstudententätigkeit.

  • Du bringst gute Kenntnisse in der Rechnungslegung mit und kennst die Grundlagen der Buchhaltung; in neue Themen arbeitest du dich mit Freude ein.

  • Du arbeitest sicher mit Excel

  • Kenntnisse von Buchhaltungssystemen wie SAP sind von Vorteil

  • Du bist offen für den Einsatz von KI und hast Freude daran, wiederkehrende Aufgaben schlauer zu lösen.

  • Du arbeitest verlässlich, genau und strukturiert, bringst analytisches Denken mit und schaust gerne über den Tellerrand, um bestehende Prozesse zu hinterfragen und zu verbessern.

  • Du hast Spaß an der Arbeit in einem dynamischen, schnellen Umfeld und bringst Eigenmotivation und Einsatzbereitschaft mit, um wirklich etwas zu bewegen.

  • Du sprichst fließend Deutsch (mindestens C1 Level) und gut Englisch.

 

Was wir sonst noch bieten

data.description:

About the Role:

Hi there! We're hiring an Information Security Engineer with a focus on Application Security to join our Information Security team at Camunda.

We are a team that takes security seriously without making it feel like a locked door. We work in a transparent, straightforward way, and we care about doing the work right rather than just checking a compliance box.

You will work side by side with our R&D engineers: reviewing designs, threat modeling new features, digging into code and helping teams make good, risk-based decisions about the vulnerabilities that come in. You'll also help build the internal tools that make this work scale, including our CVE registry and the LLM-assisted workflows we use to analyse code and triage findings.

Camunda is an AI-first company, and InfoSec is no exception: AI agents are part of how we review code, assess vulnerabilities, and build our tools. You will help shape how that works.

This is a hands-on role for someone who already has solid AppSec foundations and wants to grow. We are a generalist team, so you will also take part in our on-call rotation and incident response, and get exposure to other areas of security. But most of your time will be spent with engineers and building and maintaining internal tools and processes.

What You Will Do

  • Vulnerability management: triage findings from SCA, container and code scanning, external reports and internal security testing; assess whether Camunda is actually affected; agree fix / mitigate / accept with engineering and follow through to release.

  • Threat modeling and security reviews: run threat modeling sessions and design reviews with R&D teams for new features and architecture changes, and turn the results into concrete, prioritised actions.

  • Code analysis with LLMs: use and improve LLM-assisted tooling (agents, prompts, reusable skills) to review code, validate findings and reproduce issues, while applying your own judgement to know when the model is wrong.

  • Build internal security tooling: contribute to the CVE registry and related automation that connects scanners, engineering teams, and customer communication. Much of it is built on Camunda itself.

  • Help engineers do the secure thing by default: answer questions, review pull requests, improve guidelines and occasionally run a session or workshop.

  • On-call and incident response: share the InfoSec on-call rotation with the other engineers and help investigate and resolve security incidents.

  • Support the wider team: help write security advisories for our customers, answer customer security questions and support audits.

What You Will Bring to the Role

  • Around 3+ years in security or software engineering, with at least 2 of them working on application or product security (AppSec, product security, pentesting, or a security-focused developer role all count).

  • Experience at a SaaS or software product company, working closely with engineering teams that ship often through modern CI/CD and cloud environments.

  • Hands-on vulnerability triage: you've worked with tools like Snyk, Trivy, Semgrep, CodeQL or similar, can tell a real issue from a false positive, and can explain how exploitable something actually is in context (CVSS, exploitability, configuration).

  • Threat modeling and design review experience (e.g. STRIDE) on real systems, ideally web apps, APIs, or distributed services.

  • You read and write code. You're comfortable reading Java (Camunda is built on it) well enough to follow a data flow and spot a security bug. You can write scripts and small tools and contribute to an existing codebase with review.

  • You build with AI, not just chat with it. You use AI coding agents (Claude Code, Cursor, Copilot or similar) in your daily work to write tools, analyse code or automate tasks. And you know their output still needs a second look, especially when it comes to security.

  • Clear, friendly communication with engineers. You see yourself as an enabler, not a gatekeeper, and you can explain risk to people who aren't security specialists.

Nice to haves

  • Some Python and/or JavaScript experience, or experience building internal tools.

  • Willingness to learn and use Camunda, since we build a lot of our own security automation on it. Prior BPMN / workflow experience is a plus.

  • Experience responding to security incidents or being part of an on-call rotation.

  • Exposure to security advisories, CVE disclosure or bug bounty programmes.

  • Knowledge of AI/LLM security risks (OWASP Top 10 for LLMs / agentic apps, prompt injection, tool abuse).

  • Experience securing Kubernetes or container-based workloads, or open-source / B2B software.

About the role:

Curious about the kind of challenges you'll work on at Camunda? Watch this quick 30-minute talk from our engineers to learn more about the new Camunda Exporter and how we’re solving complex problems at scale

What You’ll Be Doing:

We are looking for a Product Builder to join the IDP & RPA pod. You will take real problems from customers, decide what is worth solving, and build and ship the solution yourself, using AI tools to get from idea to production quickly without lowering the bar.

Product Building is how Camunda's Experience organization builds the applications people use on top of Camunda 8, such as Hub, Operate, and ProcessOS. Small pods of builders own a product area from customer problem to shipped change, with no hand-offs between product management, design, and engineering. We are setting this model up now, so you will help shape how it works.

The IDP & RPA pod builds how Camunda processes work with documents and legacy applications. With intelligent document processing (IDP), customers create extraction and classification templates in Camunda Hub and publish them so a process can use AI to turn invoices and other documents into structured data. With robotic process automation (RPA), customers integrate legacy applications that have no APIs, using Robot Framework scripts on a standalone RPA worker. The hard problems come with putting LLMs into customer processes: extraction quality, model and prompt choices, testing and trust, and working for AI agents as well as for people.

What You Will Do

  • Help shape product direction for IDP & RPA by combining customer input, usage data, and field feedback into clear priorities.

  • Partner with the other builders and product strategy to turn problems into shipped features, using short written proposals and prototypes to align early.

  • Make judgment calls with incomplete information within your scope and own the outcome.

  • Communicate trade-offs and decisions clearly to stakeholders who don't live in the details the way you do.

  • Use AI tools across the whole loop, from specs to prototypes to production-ready code, and hold a high bar for what you ship by reviewing and improving the output rather than accepting it.

  • Build, test, and ship improvements to the IDP & RPA experience, reading errors and tracing issues far enough to give your pod useful context.

  • Talk to customers and to support and customer success colleagues about how IDP is used and where it breaks, and turn what you learn into decisions about what to build next.

  • Pick up customer incidents and trace them across Hub, the connectors, and the deployed process of the customer.

  • Track what you ship against real outcomes and adjust when the data tells you to.

We want you as a talented intern to help us in our mission by contributing to the development, justification and validation of our Environmental Control and Life Support System (ECLSS).

data.title: Fleet Charger (Night)
data.description:
About HIVED 📦

At HIVED, we’re steamrolling forward as one of Europe’s fastest growing startups, and our momentum shows no signs of slowing.

Based in London, we are a climate and logistics start-up building the first sustainable parcel delivery network at scale, powered by a 100% electric fleet. In an ever-growing industry where unreliable service has long been the norm, HIVED has been built from the ground-up to meet the demands of modern consumers and disrupt parcel delivery.

A tech company at heart, our talent and technology is laser-focused on delivering the best possible delivery experience for end-customers and meeting the needs of our retail partners. From our drivers to our data engineers, we are constantly working to improve this customer experience that makes us deliver better.

Already trusted by leading international brands such as John Lewis, Nespresso, Uniqlo, H&M brands and more, we are solidifying our position as the leaders in Europe to tackle this growing market.

Our tight-knit team is made up of ex-Revolut, Bain, HelloFresh, ASOS, Apple and Google employees, and we are backed by some of Europe’s leading investors and VCs in climate-tech, logistics and mobility including Planet A Ventures, Maersk Growth, Pale Blue Dot VC, Eka Ventures, NordicNinja VC and the British government. We’re passionate about driving innovation and redefining the future of delivery.

 
 

Role Overview 📝

The Night Charger is responsible for ensuring all vehicles correctly charged and ready for next-day operations (incl HGV). They must operate fairly independently, and so needs to be self-motivated and to work efficiently to a plan.

The role owns should escalate vehicle or charging issues quickly, and must operate with exceptional care to avoid damage or accidents.

The Night Charger also supports basic depot tasks during downtime.

This is a safety-critical night role with direct impact on fleet readiness and morning dispatch.

 

What you’ll be doing 🚀

  • Charge all vehicles overnight according to plan.

  • Safely move vehicles between yard, charging points, and parking locations.

  • Ensure all vehicle and charging issues are logged and escalated using standard inspection processes.

  • Drive vehicles carefully and defensively at all times; zero tolerance for accidents.

  • Plan charging sequences to accommodate longer charging times for HGVs

  • Monitor charging sessions to ensure vehicles are charging correctly

  • Use external charging infrastructure when required to maintain fleet
    readiness.

  • Safely move vehicles within the depot yard to and from charging
    points.

  • Assist with organising depot activity during overnight operations.

  • Support team coordination when acting in a supervisory capacity.

  • Support basic depot tasks (e.g. sortation, handling) when charging activity is complete.

    • Assist with moving equipment, organising cages, or general depot tasks.

    • Maintain safe working practices across all activities.

    • Support warehouse or depot teams during quieter periods if operationally required.

  • Maintain a clean, safe charging and yard environment.

  • Carry out minor overnight fixes where appropriate, such as:

    • Jump starting vehicles

    • Replacing or reconnecting 12V batteries

    • Inflating or replacing tyres (if trained)

What we’re looking for 🔎

  • 1-3 years’ experience operating in operational roles or vehicle-related roles.

  • Valid van driving licence is required - >21 years’ old, licence held for >1 year, 0 points on licence.

  • Experienced, confident and safe vehicle handling, especially at night.

  • Comfortable working independently and following clear instructions.

  • High attention to detail and safety awareness.

  • Flexible, willing to support general depot tasks when required.

  • Reliable, punctual, and able to work night shifts.

  • Able to communicate effectively & build relationships.

  • Valid HGV licens may be required.

  • Understanding of electric vehicle charging processes.

  • Basic vehicle troubleshooting ability.

Our Values

  • 😊 We Are Kind - Kind to the planet, our team and our partners. We listen with purpose, leave our egos at the door and aren't afraid to make difficult decisions. We must never confuse kindness with being "nice" - it requires us to be fair, consistent, honest, thoughtful and compassionate.

  • 🤝 We Are Tenacious - We fight every day to keep the customer promise, for every parcel entrusted to us. No matter how hard it gets or whatever stands in our way, we are relentless in our pursuit of excellence.

  • 💡 We Are Curious - We never settle, constantly challenge convention and are never afraid to ask why. We believe there is always more to learn, always a better way, and that we're always only just getting started. We never fight the urge to be inquisitive, to understand the world around us and to explore where others might not.

  • 🌍 We Are Resourceful - Our planet's resources are scarce and our future depends on our ability to use them wisely. Waste is the enemy. We strive to do more with less, be more efficient and make the most of what we have.

How we reward our team 🎁

  • Dynamic working environment with a diverse and driven team

  • Huge opportunity for learning in a high growth environment, with progression opportunities based on success in the role

  • 25 days of holiday allowance plus public holidays

    • if you're on a 4 days on - 4 days off shift pattern, you are entitled to the equivalent of 18 days paid holiday plus public holidays

data.title: Strategy Analyst - Operations Strategy & CRM
data.description:
The company

Small businesses move fast. Opportunities often don’t wait, and cash flow pressures can appear overnight. To keep going, and growing, SMEs need finance that’s as flexible and responsive as they are.

That's why we built iwoca. Our smart technology, data science and five-star customer service ensures business owners can act with the speed, confidence and control they need, exactly when it's needed.

We’ve already cleared the way for 100,000 businesses with more than £4 billion in funding. Our passionate team is driven to help even more SMEs succeed, through access to better finance and other services that make running a business easier. Our ultimate mission is to support one million SMEs in their defining moments, creating lasting impact for the communities and economies they drive.

The team

Our Operations teams deliver exceptional customer service, and the Operations Strategy & CRM team helps make that possible. We exist to understand Operations performance, find efficiencies and improve the service our customers receive. Our contact strategy is a core part of this, reaching customers at every stage, from sign-up to collections. Getting this right means customers get what they need without having to get in touch, so our teams can focus where they add most value.

The role

As a Strategy Analyst, you’ll run the projects that decide when and how iwoca contacts its customers through our in-house CRM system. You’ll steer which experiments the team runs, with customer lifetime value as your key metric. You’ll work closely with the Senior CRM Executive, who will bring your changes to life in the messages customers receive. The role will include:

  • Contact strategy. You’ll find the points in the customer journey where a message adds the most value. You’ll weigh the conversion a message brings against the risk of contacting customers too often. You’ll balance short-term gains against long-term customer value, and decide when an automated message is enough and when a person from Operations should step in.

  • Model-driven emails. We’ve started using a model to choose who receives some of our emails. You’ll be responsible for understanding where this approach works well, and collaborate with the data science team to make any improvements.

  • Split tests. You’ll design, run, and interpret controlled experiments on customer contact. For example, you might test the timing and content of emails at key points in the customer journey. You’ll apply statistical thinking so decisions rest on evidence.

  • Ownership and growth. You’ll manage analytical and strategic projects end-to-end. You’ll share findings and recommendations directly with senior leadership, and join iwoca’s wider community of analysts and data scientists.

The requirements

Essential:

  • Commercial experience. You’ve worked in strategy, analytics, product, finance, or consulting. You understand how to use data to make commercial decisions on revenue, cost, or risk that the business acts on.

  • Quantitative foundations. You have a strong analytical background, either through academic qualifications (such as a STEM background) or through relevant professional experience. You can reason about uncertainty, grounded in the underlying statistics.

  • First-principles thinking. You break complex problems into their core parts, decide which to tackle first, and iterate systematically to a solution.

  • Communication. You write and speak clearly, directly, and concisely. You adapt technical detail for your audience.

  • AI leverage. You know how to use AI to optimise your workflows, for example by checking your analysis or improving your write-ups. You judge when to use it and when not to.

Bonus:

  • Experimentation. You have designed, run, and interpreted controlled experiments, including A/B tests, to inform operational or product decisions.

  • Model-based decisions. You have used the results of statistical or machine learning models to make commercial decisions. You don’t need to build the models yourself, but you know how to question their output and act on it.

  • Coding abilities. You have experience using Python or SQL - either directly or through coding tools like Claude Code. If you haven’t coded before we’d want you to be excited to learn on the job so you can make the most out of iwoca’s vast amounts of data!

The salary

We expect to pay from £60,000 – £70,000 for this role. But, we’re open-minded, so definitely include your salary goals with your application. We routinely benchmark salaries against market rates, and run quarterly performance and salary reviews.

The culture

At iwoca, we prioritise a culture of learning, growth, and support, and invest in the development of our team members. We value thought and skill diversity, and encourage people to explore new areas of interest, adopt better tools – including AI – and apply sound judgement so our products and decisions improve over time.

The offices

We put a lot of effort into making iwoca a great place to work:

  • Offices in London, Leeds, Berlin, and Frankfurt with plenty of drinks and snacks.

  • Events and community-led groups, including running groups, padel, and monthly ping-pong and pool competitions.

The benefits

  • Flexible working hours.

  • Medical insurance from Vitality, including discounted gym membership.

  • A choice between a dedicated dental plan or a health cash plan that reimburses everyday medical expenses.

  • A private GP service (separate from Vitality) for you, your partner, and your dependents.

  • 25 days’ holiday per year, an extra day off for your birthday, the option to buy or sell an additional five days of annual leave, and unlimited unpaid leave.

  • A one-month, fully paid sabbatical after four years.

  • Instant access to external counselling and therapy sessions for team members that need emotional or mental health support.

  • 3% Pension contributions on total earnings.

  • An employee equity incentive scheme.

  • Generous parental leave and a nursery tax benefit scheme to help you save money.

  • Electric car scheme and cycle to work scheme.

  • Two company retreats a year: we’ve been to France, Italy, Spain, and further afield.

And to make sure we all keep learning, we offer:

  • A learning and development budget for everyone.

  • Company-wide talks with internal and external speakers.

  • Access to learning platforms like Treehouse.

At Harvey, we’re transforming how legal and professional services operate. By combining frontier agentic AI, an enterprise-grade platform, and deep domain expertise, we’re reshaping how critical knowledge work gets done for decades to come.

This is a rare chance to help build a generational company at a true inflection point. We have strong product-market fit and world-class investor support. We’re scaling fast and defining a new category in real time. The work is ambitious, the bar is high, and the opportunity for growth — personal, professional, and financial — is unmatched.

Our team moves fast, takes ownership, and is deeply committed to the mission — operating with intensity, staying close to our customers, and pushing each other for excellence. We live by three values: Decisiveness, Simplicity, and Job's Not Finished. We act quickly on clear judgment over perfect information, we believe simplicity is what scales, and we're never satisfied with where we are. If you want to do the best work of your career alongside people who share that drive, we'd love to build with you.

At Harvey, the future of professional services is being written today — and we’re just getting started.

Role Overview

Reporting to the VP, Legal Engineering & Regulatory Investigations, you will lead Harvey's Legal Engineering teams across EMEA.

You will directly manage Legal Engineering Managers and oversee the teams focused on supporting Harvey's pre-sales customer engagements. This is a second-line leadership role focused on organizational leadership, operational excellence, and cross-functional execution. This role will take full responsibility for establishing and defining the regional strategy for Harvey's Legal Engineering function as we scale.

Success in this role requires exceptional people leadership, strong business judgment, and the ability to build systems and processes that enable teams to operate effectively at scale. You will partner closely with leaders across Product, Engineering, Sales, Customer Success, and Operations to deliver exceptional outcomes for customers while helping shape the future of Legal Engineering at Harvey.

What You'll Do

  • Lead, develop, and scale a team of Legal Engineering Managers and their organizations serving Harvey's in-house customers.

  • Build the systems, processes, and operating mechanisms that enable Legal Engineering to deliver exceptional customer outcomes at scale.

  • Partner closely with Product, Engineering, Sales, Customer Success, and Operations to align priorities and drive execution across the business.

  • Act as a trusted advisor to law firm and legal department leaders and an influential partner to senior stakeholders across Harvey.

  • Drive organizational performance through effective planning, resource management, talent development, and operational excellence.

  • Help define the future of Legal Engineering.

What You Have

  • Qualified lawyer with 12+ years of post-qualification experience (PQE).

  • Experience practicing law at a top-tier law firm and/or in-house at a leading company, with significant client-facing experience.

  • Experience leading managers and manager-led organizations, not solely individual contributors.

  • Demonstrated success building and scaling high-performing teams in complex, fast-paced environments.

  • Experience owning organizational systems, processes, and operating models.

  • Proven ability to build strong cross-functional partnerships and drive results across multiple stakeholders.

  • Strong track record of managing upward and influencing senior leaders.

  • Experience representing an organization externally and building trusted relationships with executive-level stakeholders.

  • Deep understanding of law firms and enterprise legal teams, including corporate, litigation, investigations, regulatory, compliance, and legal operations functions, as well as the evolving legal technology landscape.

  • Exceptional communication, leadership, and organizational skills.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience leading teams outside of a traditional law firm hierarchy.

  • Experience in legal technology, professional services, consulting, legal innovation, legal operations, or other customer-facing organizations.

  • Experience operating in a high-growth technology company.

  • Experience leading globally distributed teams.

  • Demonstrated ability to create structure and drive execution in rapidly evolving environments.

  • Experience working across multiple legal practice areas, including corporate, litigation, investigations, regulatory, compliance, and legal operations.

data.description:
1Password is growing. We’ve surpassed $500M in ARR and we’re continuing to accelerate, earning a spot on the Forbes Cloud 100 for four years in a row and teaming up with iconic partners like Oracle Red Bull Racing.

About 1Password

At 1Password, we’re building the foundation for a safe, productive digital future. Our mission is to unleash employee productivity without compromising security by ensuring every identity is authentic, every application sign-in is secure, and every device is trusted. We innovated the market-leading enterprise password manager and pioneered Unified Access Management, a new cybersecurity category built for the way people and AI agents work today. As one of the most loved brands in cybersecurity, we take a human-centric approach in everything from product strategy to user experience. Over 180,000 businesses, from Fortune 100 leaders to the world’s most innovative AI companies, trust 1Password to help their teams securely adopt the SaaS and AI tools they need to do their best work.

If you're excited about the opportunity to contribute to the digital safety of millions, to work alongside a team of curious, driven individuals, and to solve hard problems in a fast-paced, dynamic environment, then we want to hear from you. Come join us and help shape a safer, simpler digital future.

Own a specific geographical region or country within the EMEA market which includes target-accounts and an existing book of business that has companies with 3000+ employees. Primary focus is on hunting new business opportunities, building sales pipeline, and driving growth within the ENT sector. Upscaling existing account base through expansion and upsell, leveraging our Extended Access Management Identity.

 

How we’re using AI today

Across GTM, we’re transforming the way we work with AI. We expect every seller, CSM, and team member to become a power user, using it daily to work smarter and move faster. AI is already embedded in how we operate – from real-time coaching that sharpens how we sell and interact with customers, to surfacing insights that help us anticipate needs – creating more time for meaningful customer engagement. If you’re excited to reshape how you think, make decisions, and drive growth with AI, you’ll feel right at home here.

 

Expectations of this role

This is a remote opportunity within the UK.


You will also regularly engage in customer-facing activities, including in-person meetings, events, and other travel required to effectively support your territory. Travel within your assigned territory, and occasionally outside of it, will be a part of your job, and you are responsible for managing your schedule in a way that works for the company and you.

Note: All go-to market roles will have an in-person onboarding in Toronto.

 

What we're looking for:

  • 5+ years of SaaS sales experience, preferably in security with a focus on Enterprise accounts OR top performance in MidMarket/Commercial and ready to step up.

  • Proven Enterprise AE success; Southern Europe enterprise selling experience; cybersecurity or identity background; evidence of personally creating and closing complex enterprise opportunities.

  • Experience building an immature/whitespace territory; CISO and senior security buyer relationships; strong new-logo hunting record; experience balancing strategic deals with volume; MEDDPICC or comparable enterprise sales methodology.

  • (EMEA) Demonstrated success in owning and growing a geographical territory or country within EMEA.

  • Proven track record of meeting or exceeding sales quotas and KPIs.

  • Outstanding sales skills in prospecting, pipeline building, strategic account planning, value-based selling, and territory management, with meticulous operating rigor in pipeline management, forecasting, and pacing to target

  • Demonstrated success in upselling & cross-selling to both new customers and across a book of business, and in uncovering customer pain points beyond what's initially shared

  • Proficient skills in business acumen, negotiation, relationship building, communication & presentation skills to C-Suite

  • Demonstrated ability to understand and articulate complex cybersecurity concepts, particularly in Identity and Access Management.

  • Self-motivated, driven, and able to work independently in a remote setting.

  • Preferable proficiency with Salesforce, Slack, Zoom, Linkedin Sales Navigator & Outreach

 

Nice to have:

  • Existing channel relationships; Middle East and Africa experience; Italian and/or Spanish language capability.

 

Please note that this job description is subject to modifications and is not an exhaustive list of responsibilities.

 

What you can expect:

  • Own Your Territory: Manage and grow your designated geographical region or country within EMEA, focusing on acquiring new ENT clients and expanding existing accounts.

  • Manage Pipeline: Build and maintain a healthy sales pipeline through proactive prospecting (cold calling, and networking), supplemented with inbound leads and effective pipeline development inline with our sales methodology.

  • Drive New Business Growth: Key Activities for effective sales strategies to meet and exceed sales targets including:

    • Strategic Territory Segmentation: Refine client targeting by segmenting against Ideal Customer Profiles (ICPs) that align with enterprise needs and priorities.

    • Contextual Business Understanding & Multithreading: Develop deep insights into the enterprise's structure, key decision-makers, and buying processes. Implement multithreading to engage various stakeholders across departments, ensuring broad influence and deeper engagement.

    • Excellence in Outbound & Pipeline Generation: Leverage a combination of self-generated outreach, BDR collaboration, and marketing-driven initiatives to consistently build a high-quality pipeline.

    • Tailored Discovery & Scoping: Align 1Password’s value to the enterprise's unique challenges through comprehensive discovery and scoping, ensuring that proposed solutions are relevant and impactful at scale.

    • Continuous Improvement via Coaching: Maintain a growth mindset by actively participating in high-quality coaching sessions, driving incremental improvements in sales performance weekly

  • Drive Organic Growth: Identify opportunities to expand and cross-sell 1Password’s solutions within existing accounts by building key stakeholder relationships and leveraging your understanding of Extended Access Management.

  • Engage the Industry: Attend industry events, trade shows, and conferences to represent 1Password, build brand presence and build relationships with potential customers

  • Stay Informed: Stay up to date on cybersecurity trends and developments, particularly in Identity and Access Management, to provide valuable insights to clients and position 1Password as an industry leader.

  • Collaborate Cross-Functionally:

    • Internal Collaboration: Foster strong partnerships with internal teams such as BDR, Solutions, Channels, Onboarding, and Customer Success to craft tailored solutions that address the complex needs of enterprise clients, ensuring alignment across the customer journey.

    • Multithreaded Client Engagement: Develop and maintain relationships across multiple stakeholders within enterprise client organizations, including C-level, IT, and security teams. This approach ensures a comprehensive understanding of the client's business, enhancing account health and expanding long-term value.

  • Focus on Solution-Driven Selling:

    • Implement 1Password methodology to ensure our solutions are strategically aligned with client goals and tailored to their specific needs.

    • Demonstrate a comprehensive understanding of client challenges, and position our offerings as impactful, customized solutions that drive value and outcomes.

  • Present and Negotiate:

    • Confidently present to executives, articulating the value proposition of our products and services.

    • Create mutual action plans to align the sales team and prospects on responsibilities, steps and timelines for closing deals.

    • Utilize effective negotiation skills to drive mutually beneficial outcomes.

 

UK-based roles only: The annual base salary for this role is between £87,000 GBP and £126,000 GBP, and is commission-eligible. This role is also immediate participation in 1Password's benefits program (health, dental, pension, and many others), utilization of our generous paid time off, an equity grant and, where applicable, participation in our incentive programs.

At 1Password, we approach each individual's compensation with a promise of fair market value and internal equity commensurate with experience and specific skill set.

This posting is for an existing vacancy.


Our culture
At 1Password, we prioritize collaboration, clear and transparent communication, receptiveness to feedback, and alignment with our core values: keep it simple, lead with honesty, and put people first.

You’ll be part of a team that challenges the status quo, and is excited to experiment and iterate in search of the best solution. That said, 1Password is not for everyone. Our work is demanding, we strive for excellence, and the pace is fast. We need people who are keen to take on challenging problems, who seek feedback to grow, and who are driven to make an impact. If you're looking for a place where you can settle into a comfortable routine, this might not be the right fit for you. We’re looking for individuals who are proven experts in their fields, as well as those who are highly adaptable, can thrive in ambiguity and through change, are curious, and above all deliver results.

How we work with AI
We are committed to leveraging cutting-edge technology—including AI—to achieve our mission. We also understand that thinking critically about AI in its current forms will help us create better solutions for our customers and ourselves with its future forms, which will help us continue to close the gap between security and privacy and achieve our mission. We want team members at all levels to take the approach of actively learning AI best practices, identifying opportunities to apply AI in meaningful ways, and driving innovative solutions in their daily work. Embracing the future of AI isn't just encouraged—it's an essential part of how we will be successful at 1Password.

 

This approach extends to our hiring process—candidates are welcome to use AI tools responsibly and thoughtfully during the application process.


Our approach to work
We recognize the power of both in person collaboration and remote work. Some roles are designated as remote-first, with an expectation that individuals work from their homes majority of the time, while others are designated as in-office roles, with an expectation of being on-site on a regular basis. We recognize that certain roles benefit from regular, in-person connection to support collaboration, team cohesion, and customer engagement.

For all roles, occasional travel may be required. This includes things like: department-wide offsites, quarterly department meetings and periodic customer events. These events are typically held in varying locations across Canada, USA and/or EMEA. In leadership roles, you can expect to travel once per month on average.

Note: All go-to market roles will have an in-person onboarding in Toronto.


What we offer
We believe in working hard, and rewarding that hard work through our benefits. While not an exhaustive list, here is a glance at what we currently offer:

Health and wellbeing
👶 Maternity and parental leave top-up programs
🩺 Competitive health benefits
🏝 Generous PTO policy

Growth and future
📈 RSU program for most employees
💸 Retirement matching program
🔑 Free 1Password account

Community
🤝 Paid volunteer days
🏆 Peer-to-peer recognition through Bonusly
🌎 Remote-first work environment
*Some roles in our GTM team are currently being hired for in-person hybrid work in Toronto and Austin. These roles will specify on the posting.

You belong here.

1Password is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to fostering an inclusive, diverse and equitable workplace that is built on trust, support and respect. We welcome all individuals and do not discriminate on the basis of gender identity and expression, race, ethnicity, disability, sexual orientation, colour, religion, creed, gender, national origin, age, marital status, pregnancy, sex, citizenship, education, languages spoken or veteran status. Be yourself, find your people and share the things you love.

Accommodation is available upon request at any point during our recruitment process. If you require an accommodation, please speak to your talent acquisition partner or email us at ----- and we’ll work to meet your needs.

Remote work is a part of our DNA. Given that our company was founded remotely in 2005, we can safely say we're experts at building remote culture. That said, remote work at 1Password does mean working from your home country. If you've got questions or concerns about this, your talent partner would be happy to address them with you.

Successful applicants will be required to complete a background check that may consist of prior employment verification, reference checks, education confirmation, criminal background, publicly available social media, credit history, or other information, as permitted by local law.

data.title: Senior Product Manager (Retail Media)
data.description:
OUR MISSION

To become the car-changing destination of choice. By combining technology, media and deep automotive expertise, we've turned how people buy, sell, advertise and lease cars on its head.

What started as a simple reviews site is now one of the largest online car-changing destinations in Europe. Last year alone we grew over 50% with nearly £3bn worth of cars bought on site, while £1.8bn of cars were listed for sale through our Sell My Car service.

In 2024 we went big and acquired Autovia - creators of AutoExpress and Evo magazines - doubling our audience overnight. Together we now have one of the biggest YouTube channels in the world with almost 10m subscribers and over 1.1 billion annual views, while we sell 1.2 million print copies of our magazines and have an annual web content reach over 350million.

And we’re a long way from done!

THE OPPORTUNITY

Millions of people come to Carwow when they are ready to change their car. That is some of the highest-intent automotive audience in the UK, and it makes Carwow one of the most valuable places for dealers and manufacturers to reach buyers at the moment of decision. Retail media is how we turn that intent into revenue, for our partners and for the business.

We have built the foundations: sponsored placements across the buying journey, a growing media and audience offering, and commercial products for dealers and manufacturers. Demand is ahead of what we can currently serve. If we can make our advertising products smarter, more relevant and easier to buy, we grow revenue for partners while keeping the experience useful for the consumer. That balance is the job.

This role is the product voice for retail media: setting the direction for what we build and working day to day with engineering, design, data and commercial teams to build it.

This is also a moment where AI changes what's possible. Advertisers want smarter targeting, better recommendations on where to spend, and proof of what worked. We want to build those things. The PM in this role will need the curiosity to explore what that could look like, and the rigour to distinguish genuine value from noise.

If you know retail media inside out, want to shape a fast-growing revenue line, and build things with a direct line to commercial outcomes, this is it.

 

WHAT YOU'LL BE DOING

  • Product Strategy & Execution:

    • Set the product direction for Carwow's retail media products, defining what we build, in what order, and why

    • Lead discovery with advertisers and internal teams: interviews, campaign data and marketplace analysis, to build a precise understanding of where we can add the most value

    • Identify and test opportunities to bring AI into our advertising products: smarter targeting, relevancy and recommendations that actually change results Work in partnership with the Technical Engineering Manager and Designer, and collaborate with the engineers in your team, to ship well-scoped solutions with clear success metrics

    • Manage the backlog with commercial awareness, prioritising work that drives revenue, advertiser performance and consumer relevance, not just activity

  • Technical & Data Partnership:

    • Work closely with engineers on how ads are served, targeted, priced and measured, and make sound trade-offs between build, buy and integrate

    • Own measurement: run controlled tests so every new placement or format proves its revenue impact without harming the consumer experience

    • Use data directly, interrogating campaign and marketplace performance to guide decisions

  • Cross-functional Leadership:

    • Work across product, engineering, commercial, campaign operations and marketing to align on priorities and ship coherently

    • Communicate strategy and trade-offs clearly to leadership and stakeholders, written as well as verbal

    • Support the commercial team in partner conversations where product context matters: capability deep-dives, roadmap discussions, strategic accounts


WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

  • Proven retail media experience is a prerequisite: you have built or owned sponsored ads, onsite media or audience products at a marketplace, retailer or ad tech business, and you know how the industry works

  • 5+ years of product management experience, with evidence of growing advertising revenue or advertiser performance

  • Technically strong: you understand ad serving, targeting, auction and pricing mechanics, APIs and tracking, and can hold a credible conversation with engineers about architecture and trade-offs

  • Comfortable with data: you interrogate performance data yourself, design your own tests, and form your own hypotheses rather than waiting for analysis to land in your inbox

  • Great stakeholder skills: you build trust with commercial teams, technical partners, advertisers and senior leaders, push back when needed, and come with solutions rather than problems

  • Clear written and verbal communication; you can explain a complex trade-off simply and bring people with you

NICE TO HAVE

  • Experience in automotive, marketplace or two-sided products

  • Hands-on use ofAI tools in your own work, and experience shipping AI-powered features

  • Experience with ad serving platforms, offsite media or CRM monetisation Experience taking new products to market, including pricing, GTM planning and launch

 

INTERVIEW PROCESS

  • Step 1: Talent Screening Call (30 min)

  • Step 2: Hiring Manager Call: Experience (45 min)

  • Step 3: Case Study (60 min + Task)

  • Step 4: Values Interview (45 min)

 

WHAT’S IN IT FOR YOU

  • Hybrid working

  • Competitive salary to fund that dream holiday to Bali

  • Matched pension contributions for a peaceful retirement

  • Share options - when we thrive, so do you!

  • Bupa Private Healthcare, for peace of mind, plus eyecare vouchers

  • Life Assurance for (even more) peace of mind

  • Monthly coaching sessions with Spill - our mental wellbeing partner

  • Enhanced holiday package, plus Bank Holidays

    • 28 days annual leave

    • 1 day for your wedding

    • 1 day off when you move house - because moving is hard enough without work!

    • For your third year anniversary, get 30 days of annual leave per year

    • For your tenth year anniversary, get 35 days of annual leave per year

    • Option to buy 3 extra days of holiday per year

  • Work from abroad for a month

  • Inclusive parental, partner and shared parental leave, fertility treatment and pregnancy loss policies

  • Bubble childcare support and discounted nanny fees for little ones

  • The latest tech (Macbook or Surface) to power your gif-sending talents

  • Up to £500/€550 home office allowance for that massage chair you’ve been talking about

  • Generous learning and development budget to help you master your craft

  • Regular social events: tech lunches, coffee with the exec sessions, lunch 8 learns, book clubs, social events/anything else you pester us for

  • Refer a friend, get paid. Repeat for infinite money

We know that diverse teams are strong teams, so we welcome those with alternative identities, backgrounds, and experiences to apply for this position. Business Development Manager

 

OUR MISSION

Carwow is Europe’s leading car-changing destination, transforming how people buy, sell, advertise, and lease cars through technology, media, and automotive expertise. From our beginnings as a reviews site, we’ve grown into one of the largest online marketplaces—facilitating nearly £3bn in car purchases and £1.8bn in sales listings last year alone. In 2024, we acquired Autovia (AutoExpress and Evo), doubling our audience and expanding our reach to 10 million YouTube subscribers, 1.2 million magazine sales, and 350m+ annual online readers. And we’re only just getting started.

 

YOUR MISSION

You’ll drive carwow’s buying platform adoption by winning and onboarding independent motor traders and franchise dealer groups through consultative selling and tailored demos. This is a phone-first role focused on high-volume outreach, with the flexibility to step into the field when it helps close key deals. You’ll be responsible for securing new partners, getting them bidding and buying quickly, and working with Account Management to maximise long-term growth.

 

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Sign up new dealers and drive adoption - bidding and buying - on the Sell My Car platform.

  • Generate new business via cold outreach and inbound leads, primarily over the phone, with occasional field visits when required.

  • Identify and develop opportunities to upsell additional services such as transport, wallet, stock funding, and other upcoming propositions.

  • Approach potential partners and build strong, long-term business relationships.

  • Collaborate with the Account Management team to ensure a smooth handover once accounts are up and running, and support in reactivating dealers who have become inactive.

  • Deliver engaging and persuasive pitches at all levels—from GMs and Group Buyers to Business Owners and Sole Traders.

  • Maintain accurate records in the CRM and manage data effectively.

     

KEY REQUIREMENTS

Please note: We know no candidate will tick every box, so if you feel you’re a strong fit but not an exact match, we’d still love to hear from you. Ideally, you’ll have:

  • Experience in a similar role within the automotive retail industry (essential).

  • A driven, hard-working mindset with the ability to adapt to change in a fast-growing, scale-up environment.

  • A hunter mentality with a passion for prospecting and developing new partnerships.

  • Strong influencing and negotiation skills, with proven business development experience.

  • Confidence in working with data to spot opportunities and risks, and to support growth strategies (without needing to be a data expert).

  • Excellent communication and presentation skills, with the flexibility to adapt to different audiences.

data.description:
TLDR; Davis is hiring an AI Engineer to work on the multi-agent pipeline turning raw, fragmented data into expert-grade real estate deliverables. You will make it more reliable, fast, and indistinguishable from the best human teams, then push it past what any human team could do, owning the stack end to end, from context engineering and orchestration to verification, storage and evaluation.

About Davis

Davis is an AI-native real estate company accelerating early-stage development and architectural design. Today developers coordinate 4-5 fragmented stakeholders over weeks or months. Soon they'll need only one: Davis.

We turn every input that shapes a development decision into decision-ready outputs: investor-grade feasibility studies, investment analysis, and architect-certified designs, delivered in days. Every stage pairs our proprietary AI systems with expert review, so velocity never comes at the cost of reliability.

We closed a $5.5M pre-seed co-led by Heartcore Capital and Balderton Capital, with Yellow, Evantic and Entrepreneur First, alongside angels from the founding teams of Spacemaker, Black Forest Labs, Hugging Face, Supabase, Cleo and Spore Bio. We already work with leading developers and expect to support hundreds of projects over the coming year, deepening our research, our hiring, and our coverage of the development process end to end.

Where We Operate

Early-stage development starts with a chain of high-stakes decisions, each requiring different data, different expertise, and different deliverables. Today, we deliver AI-powered outputs across the full spectrum - site sourcing, feasibility studies, architectural design, investment analysis, financial modeling, dataroom analysis, and more.

The Role

You will work on one of the core systems behind what Davis delivers. Our agents take raw, fragmented data and turn it into deliverables that real estate professionals use to make high-stakes decisions. Your job is to make that pipeline reliable, fast, and indistinguishable from work done by the best human teams - then push it beyond what any human team could do.

You can expect to:

  • Build and operate multi-agent systems that turn heterogeneous data into expert-grade deliverables across real estate development workflows.

  • Own the system end to end: infra, orchestration, context engineering, how the system selects, structures, and injects the right information so agents behave reliably at scale.

  • Ensure production-grade quality, performance, and reliability across every output we deliver to clients.

  • Sit with clients and domain experts regularly to understand their constraints, challenge your own assumptions, and make sure every output meets and even exceeds clients' expectations.

Beyond the technical depth, this role will expose you to how real estate decisions are made, how clients think, and what it takes to deliver outputs they trust. You'll develop a sharp business intuition alongside your engineering skills.

Key Responsibilities

  • Harness engineering: design and build the system layer around the model - context assembly, tool orchestration, verification, and report generation - to deliver consistent, high-quality outputs at scale.

  • Data ingestion & context assembly: handle messy, unstructured project data from heterogeneous sources and ensure agents have the right context at all times.

  • Storage & traceability: persist sources, extracted facts, intermediate results, report versions, and expert edits.

  • Expert-in-the-loop UX: design and build the review experience (annotations, edits, approvals, diffs/version history, provenance display).

  • Evaluation & benchmarking: build an internal eval harness (datasets, rubrics, regression tests, monitoring) to track agents performance over time.

What We're Looking For

  • 1.5+ years building and deploying production software at scale (APIs, reliability, testing, performance).

  • Experience building and evaluating LLM agents / multi-step workflows in real systems.

  • Proven context engineering experience: you've built systems where reliability depends on assembling the right context (RAG over heterogeneous sources, summarization, conversation state, tool outputs).

  • Deep Python expertise (clean architecture, typing, async/concurrency, strong testing culture).

  • Strong experience with databases + data modeling (structured storage, document storage, versioning).

  • Full-stack experience (you can ship a real UI), with a clear backend emphasis.

  • Comfortable building from first principles: we don't want heavy agent frameworks — we prefer a lightweight, well-engineered codebase.

Nice to Have

  • Experience operating LLM systems with observability and quality monitoring in production.

  • GIS familiarity (parcels, zoning layers, geocoding).

  • Multi-country product experience (heterogeneous sources, localization, varying rules).

  • NLP background

Why Join Us

You're joining a team of 9 at the very beginning - where every decision you make shapes the product, the culture, and the trajectory of the company. What you build here will be yours.

  • Direct impact on growth: your work doesn't sit behind three layers of review. You ship, clients use it, and you see the results. Every output you improve translates directly into revenue and reputation.

We already work with leading developers and expect to support hundreds of projects over the coming year, deepening our research, our hiring, and our coverage of the development process end to end.

The Role

The data center market is structuring fast, operators and landowners are hunting for sites, and the question they ask is one of capacity: how many megawatts of IT load does this land carry, under what scheme, and on what conditions. We answer in days where the market takes weeks. You will be the person who answers for that number.

You will run a portfolio of test fits and data center feasibility studies, with occasional work on large logistics and industry. Under the supervision of a lead architect, you take these projects from first capacity through to schematic design, and you present them to the client.

The core of the role

  • Establish a site's capacity in IT megawatts, working from the local zoning rules and operating constraints, and set out the assumptions behind it.

  • Qualify the applicable land-use category and the environmental-classification regime for industrial facilities, and derive from them the permitted height, the setbacks and the siting conditions.

  • Draw the data halls at their real grid, fully laid out, with their aisles, their air-handling units and their structural grid.

  • Compose the industrial site plan: service yards, a perimeter heavy-vehicle road, loading docks, retention basins, planted buffers, access and parking.

  • Arbitrate between schemes, one level, two levels or more, while respecting the slab-to-slab height and the zoning height cap.

  • Name the questions to put to the operator: cooling system, density per rack, electrical redundancy, hall dimensions, height.

  • Carry your number in front of the client, and defend it under challenge.

  • Place the project on its critical path: grid connection, environmental permitting, ecological surveys, preventive archaeology.

Contribute to the technology

  • Formalize data center best practice, translating the sizing cascade, the grids and the thresholds into criteria our AI teams can use.

  • Qualify the model's outputs, saying what is right, what is wrong, and on what grounds.

  • Work across the product, tech and real estate teams, inside the tool's continuous-improvement cycles.

Work as a team

  • Take part in project reviews and exchange with the other architects to improve the methods and the quality of the deliverables.

  • Contribute to the team's graphic standards.

What We’re Looking For

  • Education: a degree in architecture.

  • Experience: we count projects as much as years. Three to five years on the data center product, with two or three projects seen across their full cycle. One of them should be a project you carried yourself, from capacity through to permit or schematic design. A background in large logistics or industrial buildings is a valid base, provided you add that data center experience to it.

  • Software: mastery of Rhino and Revit is essential, and AutoCAD is expected.

  • Appetite for digital tools and AI: you do not need to code, but the drive to fold these tools into your practice and push it forward is essential.

  • Speed and synthesis: our clients decide fast, on a number. You need to produce a credible, well-drawn scenario in hours, cut to the essential on ambiguous cases, and know what level of detail serves the decision at each phase.

Domain skills

  • Product knowledge, the sizing cascade of a data center, hall, power, cooling, telecom and logistics, the slab-to-slab height and what it imposes, the rack-and-aisle grid, electrical redundancy, the order of magnitude of a PUE.

  • Applied regulatory fluency, the land-use sub-category and the 2023 ruling that reclassified data centers, the environmental-classification headings and the threshold that triggers a full environmental permit, height and setback rules, no-net-land-take targets and designation as a project of major national interest, rooftop renewable-energy requirements.

  • Buildable capacity, linking a rule to its quantified effect on a volume, and a volume to an installable power.

  • Industrial site planning, heavy-vehicle access, turning circles, fire safety, water management, insertion and edges.

  • Graphic production, plans, sections and diagrams that make a capacity argument legible to an investor.

  • Ownership of the subject, presenting, arguing and defending a number in front of a client who contests it. We are looking for someone who has owned the subject end to end, assumptions, number and client presentation.

Complementary skills

  • Rigor and a sense of synthesis, especially on ambiguous cases.

  • Structuring information, organizing what you produce so that others, human or machine, can use it.

  • An ability to work across the product, tech and real estate teams.

  • A command of technical English, the vocabulary of the sector being largely English-speaking.

Why Join Davis?

  • Take part in a genuine transformation of the real estate profession, and co-build the next generation of feasibility standards alongside a high-caliber technical team.

  • You will set Davis's data center method, and it will serve every project that follows.

  • See your work in every deliverable, and correct the tool when it gets things wrong.

  • Join a young company, where the methods and the tools are still being built, and where your expertise shapes the way we work.

Package

  • Fixed-term or permanent depending on the case, to discuss together

  • Offices in the center of Paris 2e

  • Private health insurance covered

  • Meal vouchers

  • Gym membership covered

  • 50% of commuting costs reimbursed

More information about Davis, the team and the market we’re going after:


Team

Mehdi (CEO) grew up in a family of architects and has lived this problem firsthand. He's a repeat founder who bootstrapped his first startup at 20, and graduated from Sciences Po and HEC Paris. Amine (CTO) is an AI researcher from École Polytechnique who worked extensively on discrete diffusion and turned down a PhD with Google DeepMind to build Davis. They started working together in July 2025 at Entrepreneur First's first European residency, a two-month lock-in in a German castle.

Today we're a team of 12: technical profiles from Polytechnique, ENS and INRIA alongside architects and deep real estate expertise.

We're small with an extremely high bar. If you want to work deeply on hard problems and see your work reach clients within days, you're the one we need.

Why We'll Win

Real estate is a $13 trillion industry that technology has largely bypassed. The professional services that feed it (design, engineering, feasibility, permitting) represent hundreds of billions in spend that no one has seriously automated.

Proptech spent the last decade selling SaaS on the edges of these workflows. It didn't work, for two reasons: no professional wants another tool to learn, and no tool can automate work that runs on expert judgment. Davis makes a different bet. We don't sell tools, we sell the work: AI-generated, expert-validated, delivered in days instead of weeks. Every project compounds our data advantage across typologies, geographies and regulatory contexts.

We care about who you are, not just what's on your CV.

If you're drawn to what we're building but don't meet every requirement, we still want to hear from you. Studies show that women in particular tend to apply only when they meet 100% of the criteria. If that's you, please don't let that hold you back. We'd love to receive your application.

data.title: Finance Ops
data.description:
About Inbolt

Deploying an industrial robot still takes months of integration and programming, and the moment a part, a process, or a position changes, it starts over. Inbolt makes it take minutes.

Our generalist vision model gives robots the ability to see, think, and adapt in real time, so any robot can master any process, part, or station. Set up from a CAD model in minutes and compatible with FANUC, ABB, KUKA, Yaskawa, Comau, and Universal Robots, Inbolt runs in production at Stellantis, Toyota, Ford, GM, Bosch and more, with 200+ systems live across 100+ factories on three continents.

We're a team based in Paris, Detroit and Japan, and we're growing fast. Here's the role:

You'll join the finance team as Finance Ops, reporting to Jean-François, our VP Finance. It's the right seat for someone who wants to see the whole finance function of a scaling industrial company.

🎯 Responsibilities

Controlling & reporting

  • Own the month-end close: accuracy of cost allocations, accruals, prepaids and intercompany across our French, US and Japanese entities

  • Analyze financial performance against budget and targets; explain variances to the VP Finance and leadership

  • Prepare the monthly reporting package (P&L, cash, KPIs) for management, the board and investors

  • Contribute to budgeting and forecasting cycles

Operations & cash

  • Invoice customers and monitor collections; follow up on overdue payments with Sales and Deployment

  • Prepare supplier and payroll-related bank payments

  • Track down and collect missing supporting documents (invoices, POs, expense receipts) and drive the team to keep them clean

Building the function

  • Improve internal finance processes and tooling, including using AI tools to automate collection, matching and reconciliation work

  • Take over bookkeeping (AP, AR, bank, accruals, prepaids) from our external accountant over the next 12–18 months

  • Support audit, tax and grant-related requests (CIR, BPI, etc.)

🔎 Preferred experience

  • 3–4 years of experience in controlling, accounting or audit: ideally a mix (e.g. audit or expertise-comptable followed by an in-house role)

  • Experience in a startup/fast-paced environment

  • Degree in Finance, Accounting or Business (DCG, DSCG, Master CCA or equivalent)

  • Solid understanding of French GAAP, financial statements and month-end mechanics

  • Comfortable with financial analysis and budget tracking

  • Advanced Excel / Google Sheets

  • Familiarity with accounting or ERP software (Pennylane, Sage, NetSuite or similar)

  • Fluent in French and English: both required, as you'll work with our US and Japanese teams

  • Experience in leveraging or implementing AI solutions to improve and streamline financial processes

✍️ Position details

  • Team: Finance

  • Contract: CDI, full-time

  • Location: Paris (12 Rue Vivienne, 75002)

  • Work mode: 3 days minimum on site per week

  • Start date: ASAP

  • Package: 📈 stock options and 🩺 health coverage, on top of the benefits below

Why join Inbolt

  • Real impact, on real factory floors: your work runs in production at Stellantis, Toyota, Ford, GM and Bosch, across 200+ factories on three continents.

  • Ownership from day one: we value end-to-end ownership, high rigor and hands-on curiosity, and we move fast while staying precise.

  • An international team: Paris, Detroit and Japan, working closely with world-class robotics and automation partners.

  • A seat at the start of something big: we're building the default intelligence layer for every industrial robot, on every brand.

Benefits

We're building our benefits location by location, so they fit local needs and practices in each country where we operate.

  • 📍 Prime office locations in Paris and Detroit

  • 🤝 Team-building events & off-sites

  • 🐶 Bring-your-dog-to-work policy

  • 🍽️ Lunch expenses covered

  • ✈️ Customer site visits in real factories

  • and more....

Benefits may vary by location and contract type.

Our hiring process

  • Introduction call (30 min) with our Talent team, to get to know you and answer your questions.

  • Interview with your future manager, including a case study or technical exercise depending on the role.

  • Meet the team: a conversation with the people you will work with every day.

  • Final round with our founders.

  • Reference checks.

The exact steps can vary slightly by role. We keep the process short and transparent, and we'll keep you posted at every step.

Ready to give robots sight?

Inbolt is an equal opportunity employer. We welcome applications from everyone, whatever their background, and a real person reads every application. Even if you don't tick every box, if this role excites you, we'd love to hear from you.

Missions

 

🏗️ Alassio, en quelques mots

Le marché de la paie en cabinet d'expertise comptable est dominé depuis des décennies par des solutions historiques. Chez Alassio, notre ambition est de rénover le métier au bénéfice des gestionnaires de paie, avec un logiciel moderne, évolutif et pensé pour les réalités du terrain.

Lancé en juillet 2025 et déployé en clientèle depuis mars 2026, Alassio a levé 2,6 M€ en pre-seed auprès de Partech et de business angels de référence. Nous accélérons pour accompagner de nouveaux cabinets partout en France, tout en maintenant une exigence forte sur la qualité du produit et de l'accompagnement.

 

🎯 Pourquoi ce poste, maintenant

Pour un gestionnaire de paie, une question sans réponse un jour de clôture, c'est une paie en retard. La qualité du Support est un élément clé de l'accompagnement qu'Alassio propose à ses cabinets partenaires, et l'arrivée de nouveaux cabinets nous amène à constituer une équipe dédiée.

 

🚀 Ton rôle

Tu es le premier contact de nos cabinets partenaires quand ils ont une question. Ta réactivité et la clarté de tes réponses conditionnent leur confiance dans Alassio dès leurs premières semaines en production. En accompagnant les gestionnaires de paie dans leur pratique quotidienne du logiciel, tu contribues directement à la qualité du produit, et tu montes en compétences sur toute la paie et sur notre outil.

 

🧭 Ton parcours et tes missions

  • Tu te formes sur le produit, sur la paie telle qu'Alassio la calcule et sur les process de l'équipe

  • Tu prends le relais d'Alassio Intelligence, notre agent IA qui apporte la première réponse, quand un gestionnaire de paie a besoin d'un humain : tu réponds sur Intercom aux questions d'utilisation de l'outil, de paramétrage de dossier et de paie courante

  • Tu gagnes en autonomie et tiens nos standards de service : première réponse en moins de 5 minutes, satisfaction des cabinets supérieure à 98 %

  • Tu qualifies chaque demande et tu l'escalades quand il le faut, avec tous les éléments utiles : aux Consultant(e)s Support Paie & DSN pour les cas complexes de paie et de DSN, à l'équipe Tech pour les bugs

  • Tu contribues aux contenus d'aide et à la base de connaissances d'Alassio Intelligence, pour rendre les cabinets plus autonomes

  • Tu portes la voix des utilisateurs en remontant au Product des retours structurés

  • Tu testes les nouvelles fonctionnalités avant leur mise en production

 

🤝 Ton environnement

  • Rattachement : notre Lead Support Paie & DSN et Huy Anh (Resp. Métier)

  • Tu travailles au quotidien avec nos Consultant(e)s Support Paie & DSN, notre Expert(e) Métier Paie & DSN et notre Ingénieur(e) Paramétrage Paie

  • Outils : Alassio, Alassio Intelligence, Intercom, Linear, Notion, Mintlify

 

🗓️ Tes 6 premiers mois

  • À 1 mois : tu connais le produit et nos process, et tu réponds aux demandes simples avec relecture du Lead Support Paie & DSN

  • À 3 mois : tu es autonome sur le niveau 1, tu tiens nos standards et tes escalades sont complètes et bien qualifiées

  • À 6 mois : tu prends en charge tes premières demandes de niveau 2 et tu contribues régulièrement à la documentation

 
 

Profil recherché

 

🌱 Expérience

Indispensable :

  • Formation en paie (BTS, licence pro, master ou titre professionnel Gestionnaire de paie)

  • 1 à 2 ans d'expérience en paie, alternance comprise (cabinet, entreprise ou éditeur)

  • De bonnes bases : établissement du bulletin, cotisations, absences, congés payés

  • Une vraie appétence pour le numérique et de l'aisance à l'écrit

Un plus :

  • Bonnes notions de DSN

  • Pratique d'un logiciel de paie du marché

  • Expérience en relation client ou en support

  • Un parcours ou un intérêt pour la tech (formation, projets personnels)

 

💎 Qualités

  • La rigueur et le sens du service

  • La capacité à garder le cap lors des pics d'activité (clôtures de paie mensuelles, mois de janvier)

 
 

Processus de sélection

1️⃣ Appel d'introduction avec Hector (COO) : 30 min

2️⃣ Entretien et cas pratique en direct avec Huy Anh (Resp. Métier) : vérifier un bulletin et rédiger une réponse à un cabinet : 1 h

Développer tes compétences au contact d'experts et d'une équipe tech ambitieuse, dans une startup qui change le quotidien des gestionnaires de paie, et contribuer chaque jour aux améliorations du produit.

Le marché de la paie en cabinet d'expertise comptable est dominé depuis des décennies par des solutions historiques. Chez Alassio, notre ambition est de rénover le métier au bénéfice des gestionnaires de paie, avec un logiciel moderne, évolutif et pensé pour les réalités du terrain.

Lancé en juillet 2025 et déployé en clientèle depuis mars 2026, Alassio a levé 2,6 M€ en pre-seed auprès de Partech et de business angels de référence. Nous accélérons pour accompagner de nouveaux cabinets partout en France, tout en maintenant une exigence forte sur la qualité du produit et de l'accompagnement.

 

🎯 Pourquoi ce poste, maintenant

Un logiciel de paie ne vaut que par la justesse de ses règles métier. Qu'il vienne de la roadmap ou d'un cabinet, chaque sujet doit être analysé finement avant d'être développé : règles applicables, cas limites, impacts sur les bulletins et sur la DSN. Avec l'arrivée de nouveaux cabinets et l'extension d'Alassio à de nouveaux régimes, ces sujets se multiplient.

 

🚀 Ton rôle

Tu es l'analyste métier de référence de la paie chez Alassio : tu décortiques les sujets complexes et tu transformes un besoin métier en solution fiable, puis tu t'assures que ce qui est livré fonctionne vraiment pour nos cabinets. Tes sujets d'analyse viennent de deux sources : la roadmap du produit paie, et les cas les plus complexes que nous remontent nos cabinets.

 

🧭 Tes missions

  • Analyser les sujets métier de la roadmap : règles applicables, cas limites, impacts sur les bulletins et la DSN, notamment pour l'extension d'Alassio à de nouveaux régimes

  • Investiguer les cas les plus complexes escaladés par le support : écarts de calcul, anomalies et rejets DSN, régularisations ; identifier la cause et la bonne réponse (bug, évolution ou paramétrage, ce dernier étant pris en charge par l'Ingénieur(e) Paramétrage Paie)

  • Formaliser tes analyses en spécifications fonctionnelles pour l'équipe Tech

  • Construire les cas de test avant chaque mise en production

  • Porter des sujets de bout en bout, du cadrage à la mise en production, avec l'équipe Tech

  • Prototyper si besoin avec des outils d'IA pour valider une approche

  • Faire de chaque analyse une source d'amélioration : transformer les irritants récurrents en sujets produit, priorisés avec Huy Anh (Resp. Métier), et enrichir la documentation fonctionnelle et la base de connaissances

 

🔁 Tes rituels

  • Les kickoffs des sujets que tu portes ou sur lesquels tu interviens

  • Un triage hebdomadaire avec Huy Anh, l'Ingénieur(e) Paramétrage Paie et le support : remontées des cabinets, corrections, priorités produit

  • Le demo day de toute l'équipe, chaque vendredi midi

 

🤝 Ton environnement

🗓️ Tes 6 premiers mois
