Profil recherché

 

🌱 Expérience

Indispensable :

  • 5 à 8 ans d'expérience en paie, dont une expérience de consultant(e) chez un éditeur de paie ou en maîtrise d'ouvrage (MOA) paie

Un plus :

data.title: Change and Transformation Manager - Client Delivery (Fluency in French & English required)
data.description:
Change and Transformation Manager – Client Delivery (French/english)

Location: Paris, France (hybrid, three days a week in the office; occasional travel to Brussels and London)
Level: Programme Manager senior
Team: Client Delivery
Contract: Permanent
Reporting To: Operating Model Design Lead

Please note: This role is based in France, so you need to live here or be open to relocating, and it requires an existing right to work in the EU. We can’t offer visa sponsorship, but we review sponsorship role by role, so keep an eye on our careers site for future opportunities.

Fluent French and English (spoken and written) are essential, and we kindly ask you to submit your CV in English.

About Kaluza

Kaluza is the Energy Intelligence Platform, turning energy complexity into seamless coordination. We help energy companies overcome today’s challenges while accelerating the shift to a clean, electrified future.

Our platform orchestrates millions of real-time decisions across homes, devices, markets and grids. By combining predictive algorithms with human-centred design, Kaluza makes clean energy dependable, affordable and adaptive to everyday life.

With teams across Europe, Asia and Australia, and a joint venture with Mitsubishi Corporation in Japan, we power leading companies including OVO, AGL and ENGIE, as well as innovators like Volvo and Volkswagen.

What you’ll do

  • Own change and transformation support for go-live readiness for ENGIE France’s migration onto Kaluza as the hands-on lead, from planning through cutover, hypercare and transition towards scaling, so ENGIE’s teams are ready and confident to adopt the platform from day one.

  • Decide the change approach for the programme: stakeholder analysis, change impact assessment, training design and business readiness engagement, shaped to ENGIE France’s operating context and owned by their teams.

  • Operate Kaluza’s business readiness governance: stage gates, readiness evidence, risk and dependency tracking and weekly reporting.

  • Partner with the Learning and Adoption Specialist in France to coordinate training, Train the Trainer and knowledge content, so enablement lands throughout each programme increment as we build out and release features via Agile delivery.

  • Be the day-to-day point of contact for ENGIE France on business readiness, change and adoption, giving practical change advice to their transformation leads.

  • Track adoption and operational stability through hypercare, root-cause any shortfall against acceptance criteria, and agree interventions with ENGIE.

  • Improve Kaluza’s readiness playbook: evolve what worked on ENGIE Belgium, test fixes where it falls short in France, and share what you learn with colleagues across Client Delivery to shape the platform’s operational foundations and improvements and to set our global standards.

Day to day, the activities you’ll lead or support include:

  • Change impact and readiness planning: diagnosing the full scope of impacts across roles, workflows, systems and customer experience, then turning them into a prioritised readiness plan sequenced against delivery, migration and release cadence.

  • Stakeholders, sponsors and change networks: mapping stakeholders and influence at workstream level, helping sponsors stay visible and engaged, and shaping the champion, superuser and people-manager networks that carry change into ENGIE’s business.

  • Communications and resistance: supporting ENGIE France’s own communications and engagement strategy, so their teams and customers hear a consistent, positive story about the programme. You’ll help leaders and champions advocate for the change, internally and with customers, and anticipate where resistance may form so you can intervene before it becomes entrenched.

  • Migration and go-live readiness: building the business and operational readiness evidence that enables a smooth transfer to service, measured against the agreed acceptance criteria, and supporting the go-live command centre.

  • Hypercare and stabilisation: agreeing hypercare entry and exit criteria, monitoring stability and adoption signals, and handing over cleanly to ENGIE’s business-as-usual teams.

  • Early releases and workarounds: planning for known limitations in early releases, and reflecting them in training, knowledge and communications so users are never caught by surprise. You’ll work with Release Management so each platform release arrives with the enablement it needs.

What you’ll bring

Ideally, you’ll have:

  • Several years of hands-on change delivery on large platform or systems transformations, with a recognised change management discipline. You solve a wide range of problems creatively and work with little supervision.

  • Experience in regulated, customer-facing operational environments, including live customer account migration, cutover and go-live, where you have shaped the approach rather than only followed one.

  • Strong communication and stakeholder management, credible with client programme leads and transformation sponsors.

  • Fluency in French and English, written and spoken.

  • Comfort working with data: you explore adoption and programme data yourself, report on it clearly and challenge decisions when evidence is weak.

  • Commercial awareness: you understand how Kaluza makes money and balance what the client needs against cost, working alongside SI partners and the client’s own change resources without duplicating effort.

What will set you apart: a background in energy retail or utilities, vendor-side experience on a SaaS implementation, and/or knowledge of contact centre operations and technology.

Our Values

Five values guide how we work at Kaluza:

  • Play to win: Collective pride in decarbonising energy at scale.

  • Solve the real problem: Cutting through complexity to focus on real-world outcomes.

  • Build trust every day: Consistency, transparency and doing what we say.

  • Own the outcome: Full accountability, wins and setbacks, without ego.

  • Go further together: Collaboration, respect and different perspectives.

Our Perks

  • Financial & Insurance: Discretionary bonus, Alan Mutuelle Health Insurance, x3 Life & Death insurance (Prévoyance) via Alan, and standard Sécurité Sociale contributions (pension, family allowance, unemployment insurance)

  • Allowances: 50% commuting expense reimbursement, €200 Home Working Allowance, and €150 Learning Fund

  • Time Off & Flexibility: 25 days holiday + bank holidays + RTT days, Moments That Matter Leave, Compassionate Leave, two paid Volunteering Days, Flexible Working, and Career Break eligibility

Come as you are

We want to meet people from all walks of life. The more inclusive we are, the better our work will be, and we recognise talent on merit and potential. If you’re excited about the role but don’t tick every box, we’d still love to hear from you.

Find out more on our careers page and LinkedIn. Our Applicant Data Protection Policy is here.

Compensation: €56 – €75

Product Manager – Agent Experience

Lieu : Paris de préférence, possibilité à Londres (hybride, trois jours par semaine au bureau)
Équipe : Customer Care
Langues : Maîtrise du français et de l’anglais
Contrat : CDI
Rattachement : Lead Product Manager

À noter : ce poste est ouvert à Paris et à Londres, et nécessite un droit de travailler déjà acquis dans le pays où vous serez basé(e) (UE pour Paris, Royaume-Uni pour Londres). Nous ne pouvons pas proposer de parrainage de visa, mais nous étudions le parrainage poste par poste : gardez un œil sur notre site carrières pour de futures opportunités.

Merci de soumettre votre CV en anglais.

À propos de Kaluza

Kaluza est la plateforme d’Energy Intelligence qui transforme la complexité de l’énergie en coordination fluide. Nous aidons les énergéticiens à relever les défis d’aujourd’hui tout en accélérant la transition vers un avenir propre et électrifié.

Notre plateforme orchestre des millions de décisions en temps réel entre les foyers, les appareils, les marchés et les réseaux. En associant algorithmes prédictifs et conception centrée sur l’humain, Kaluza rend l’énergie propre fiable, abordable et adaptée à la vie de tous les jours.

Avec des équipes en Europe, en Asie et en Australie, et une joint-venture avec Mitsubishi Corporation au Japon, nous accompagnons des acteurs majeurs comme OVO, AGL et ENGIE, ainsi que des entreprises innovantes comme Volvo et Volkswagen.

Ce que vous ferez

  • Piloter la roadmap : porter la stratégie de bout en bout de Kaluza Agent Experience (KAE) sur le marché européen, en cohérence avec les objectifs produit globaux et affinée par les besoins clients locaux et les comportements des agents. Vous suivrez les indicateurs opérationnels clés (AHT, FCR, CSAT, adoption de l’IA, onboarding) pour vous assurer que chaque évolution améliore l’expérience des agents et des clients.

  • Concevoir les parcours et garantir la cohérence UX : être le garant de l’expérience agent sur l’ensemble de KAE. Vous travaillerez avec les équipes UX et métier pour appliquer des patterns communs, réduire la charge cognitive des agents et rester aligné avec le design system, y compris quand de nouvelles capacités d’automatisation et d’assistance par l’IA sont introduites.

  • Mener les intégrations et l’onboarding client : piloter les intégrations techniques et produit avec des plateformes tierces, et superviser de bout en bout le déploiement de nouvelles instances KAE pour les nouveaux clients, de la phase de découverte jusqu’à la mise en production.

  • Garantir l’accessibilité et la conformité : défendre les réglementations européennes d’accessibilité dès la conception, en traduisant les exigences réglementaires et spécifiques à chaque marché en besoins techniques concrets.

  • Accompagner les clients et créer de la valeur : être l’expert de confiance des clients sur l’expérience agent, en défendant une configuration native de la plateforme plutôt que des développements sur mesure.

  • Rester les mains dans le cambouis, de la livraison à l’accompagnement : vous impliquer sur l’ensemble du cycle de vie du développement produit (PDLC), des sessions de discovery avec les agents aux boucles de feedback, et produire les supports qui favorisent l’adoption côté clients.

(À noter : des déplacements chez les clients, par exemple à Bruxelles, sont à prévoir, environ 1 à 3 par mois au début, puis 1 à 2 par trimestre.)

Ce que vous apporterez

Idéalement, vous avez :

  • Une expertise centres de contact et UX : une solide expérience de la responsabilité de parcours utilisateurs de bout en bout pour des outils opérationnels très sollicités (par exemple des postes de travail d’agents), avec une vraie pratique de la recherche utilisateur, de la cartographie de parcours et des tests d’usabilité auprès d’agents et de superviseurs.

  • Une connaissance de l’accessibilité européenne et de l’intégration de plateformes : une bonne maîtrise des standards d’accessibilité européens, ainsi qu’une expérience avérée d’intégration de produits avec des plateformes tierces et des écosystèmes de fournisseurs complexes.

  • Une expérience de delivery client et d’expansion de marché : un historique de mise en œuvre ou de localisation d’un produit pour des clients entreprise externes, en menant les solutions de zéro à la mise en production : discovery, configuration et conduite du changement.

Notre plateforme orchestre des millions de décisions en temps réel entre les foyers, les appareils, les marchés et les réseaux. En combinant algorithmes prédictifs et conception centrée sur l’humain, Kaluza rend l’énergie propre fiable, abordable et adaptée à la vie quotidienne.

Avec des équipes en Europe, en Asie et en Australie, et une joint-venture avec Mitsubishi Corporation au Japon, nous accompagnons des acteurs majeurs comme OVO, AGL et ENGIE, ainsi que des entreprises innovantes comme Volvo et Volkswagen.

Vos missions

  • Piloter, en tant que référent(e) opérationnel(le), l’accompagnement du changement et de la transformation pour la préparation au go-live de la migration d’ENGIE France sur Kaluza, de la planification jusqu’à la bascule, l’hypercare et la transition vers le déploiement à plus grande échelle, afin que les équipes d’ENGIE soient prêtes et confiantes pour adopter la plateforme dès le premier jour.

  • Définir l’approche de conduite du changement du programme : analyse des parties prenantes, évaluation des impacts du changement, conception des formations et mobilisation pour la préparation métier, adaptées au contexte opérationnel d’ENGIE France et portées par leurs équipes.

  • Faire vivre la gouvernance de préparation métier de Kaluza : stage gates, preuves de préparation, suivi des risques et des dépendances, et reporting hebdomadaire.

  • Collaborer avec le ou la Learning and Adoption Specialist en France pour coordonner la formation, le Train the Trainer et les contenus de connaissance, afin que l’accompagnement soit en place à chaque incrément du programme, au fil de la construction et de la livraison des fonctionnalités en mode Agile.

  • Être l’interlocuteur(trice) quotidien(ne) d’ENGIE France sur la préparation métier, le changement et l’adoption, en apportant des conseils pratiques à leurs responsables de transformation.

  • Suivre l’adoption et la stabilité opérationnelle pendant l’hypercare, analyser les causes racines de tout écart par rapport aux critères d’acceptation, et convenir avec ENGIE des actions correctives.

  • Améliorer le playbook de préparation de Kaluza : faire évoluer ce qui a fonctionné sur ENGIE Belgique, tester des correctifs là où cela ne suffit pas en France, et partager vos enseignements avec vos collègues de Client Delivery pour façonner les fondations opérationnelles de la plateforme, ses améliorations et nos standards globaux.

Au quotidien, vous piloterez ou soutiendrez notamment les activités suivantes :

  • Impacts du changement et planification de la préparation : diagnostiquer l’ensemble des impacts sur les rôles, les processus, les systèmes et l’expérience client, puis les traduire en un plan de préparation priorisé, séquencé en fonction du rythme de livraison, de migration et de mise en production.

  • Parties prenantes, sponsors et réseaux du changement : cartographier les parties prenantes et leur influence au niveau de chaque chantier, aider les sponsors à rester visibles et engagés, et structurer les réseaux de champions, de super-utilisateurs et de managers qui porteront le changement au sein du business d’ENGIE.

  • Communication et résistances : soutenir la stratégie de communication et d’engagement d’ENGIE France, afin que leurs équipes et leurs clients entendent un discours cohérent et positif sur le programme. Vous aiderez les dirigeants et les champions à porter le changement, en interne comme auprès des clients, et vous anticiperez les zones où des résistances pourraient apparaître afin d’intervenir avant qu’elles ne s’installent.

  • Migration et préparation au go-live : constituer les preuves de préparation métier et opérationnelle qui permettent un transfert fluide vers l’exploitation, mesurées par rapport aux critères d’acceptation convenus, et soutenir le centre de commandement du go-live.

  • Hypercare et stabilisation : définir les critères d’entrée et de sortie de l’hypercare, suivre les signaux de stabilité et d’adoption, et assurer une passation propre aux équipes d’exploitation d’ENGIE.

  • Premières versions et solutions de contournement : anticiper les limitations connues des premières versions et les refléter dans les formations, les contenus de connaissance et les communications, pour que les utilisateurs ne soient jamais pris au dépourvu. Vous travaillerez avec le Release Management pour que chaque version de la plateforme arrive avec l’accompagnement nécessaire.

Votre profil

Idéalement, vous avez :

  • Plusieurs années d’expérience opérationnelle en conduite du changement sur de grandes transformations de plateformes ou de systèmes, avec une discipline de change management reconnue. Vous résolvez avec créativité une grande variété de problèmes et travaillez avec peu de supervision.

  • Une aisance avec les données : vous explorez vous-même les données d’adoption et de programme, vous en rendez compte clairement et vous challengez les décisions lorsque les éléments factuels sont fragiles.

  • Une sensibilité commerciale : vous comprenez comment Kaluza gagne de l’argent et savez arbitrer entre les besoins du client et les coûts, en travaillant aux côtés des partenaires intégrateurs et des ressources change du client, sans doublonner les efforts.

Lead Designer 

  • Location: Paris, France (hybrid, three days a week in the office)

  • Team: UX 

  • Contract: Permanent

  • Reporting To: Head of UX

Please note: This role requires an existing right to work in France. We can’t offer visa sponsorship, but we review sponsorship role by role, so keep an eye on our careers site for future opportunities.

About Kaluza

Kaluza is the Energy Intelligence Platform, turning energy complexity into seamless coordination. We help energy companies overcome today’s challenges while accelerating the shift to a clean, electrified future.

Our platform orchestrates millions of real-time decisions across homes, devices, markets and grids. By combining predictive algorithms with human-centred design, Kaluza makes clean energy dependable, affordable and adaptive to everyday life.

With teams across Europe, Asia and Australia, and a joint venture with Mitsubishi Corporation in Japan, we power leading companies including OVO, AGL and ENGIE, as well as innovators like Volvo and Volkswagen.


What you’ll do

  • Own UX strategy for our EU programme end to end, with real judgement over what to prioritise and how, as the market and the team's shape itself still takes form

  • Partner directly with Product, Engineering, and Data on the ground locally, including wider teams and client-side engineers,bringing user needs into decisions from the start, not added on afterward

  • Use our established research methods to bring real insight into your own design work, and feed what you learn locally back into the wider team's shared understanding

  • Lead and grow two designers based in London, building one genuinely connected team across EU and the UK from early on

  • Shape how local work becomes part of our shared platform and design system, so what you build here compounds for every client after, not just this one

  • Build directly in code where useful, using AI-assisted tools to prototype or ship small front-end changes yourself, closing the gap between design and delivery

  • Go beyond representing UX, be an active voice in the trade-offs between PMs and Design, holding the right balance between client-specific needs and our global approach, including directly with clients and stakeholders in workshops, showcases, and pre-sales conversations across the EU market

  • Help define what design leadership looks like across a genuinely distributed function, UK, EU, and Australia, while it's still being built

What you’ll bring

Ideally you’ll have/be

  • A track record owning UX strategy and delivery end to end for a complex, multi-stakeholder product, ideally in a regulated or operationally complex industry

  • Experience designing in B2B or B2B2C environments, for professional, repeat users rather than casual consumers

  • Direct experience managing or mentoring other designers, comfortable leading a small team while still doing hands-on design work yourself

  • Experience working from, and contributing back to, a shared platform or design system, not just consuming one

  • Comfort working close to code, confident using AI-assisted development tools (such as Claude Code) to go from design to a working interface yourself

  • A genuine appetite for building something from an early stage, comfortable with ambiguity that comes with shaping a team and a market presence, not just operating inside one already settled

Where you'll work
We offer flexible working, with an expectation of 3 days a week in the office. This gives us the best of both: real time together to collaborate and build relationships, with the flexibility to work in the way that suits you best the rest of the week.

Our Values

  • Play to win: Collective pride in decarbonising energy at scale.

  • Solve the real problem: Cutting through complexity to focus on real-world outcomes.

  • Build trust every day: Consistency, transparency and doing what we say.

  • Own the outcome: Full accountability, wins and setbacks, without ego.

  • Go further together: Collaboration, respect and different perspectives.

  • Financial & Insurance: Discretionary bonus, Alan Mutuelle Health Insurance, x3 Life & Death insurance (Prévoyance) via Alan, and standard Sécurité Sociale contributions (pension, family allowance, unemployment insurance)

Similar to the way Solutions Architects secure the “technical win” in the sales process, Legal Engineers secure the “legal win” by performing in-depth customer discovery and education on Harvey’s solutions through targeted meetings and demos that resonate with the customer’s day-to-day workflows specific to their legal practice area.

Legal Engineers utilize their experience practicing law and their legal mindset to ask thoughtful questions to understand the needs of law firm and in-house attorneys, develop credibility, and then partner with Account Executives to educate them on Harvey’s value via large and small group sessions as well as one-to-one conversations.

  • Partner closely with Account Executives and GTM leadership to prioritise pipeline, develop deal strategy, and support conversion on complex or strategic opportunities

  • Engage with lawyers at prospective customers to understand and address their workflow challenges

  • Collaborate with Product and Marketing to ensure the team's field insights are feeding into positioning, roadmap, and go-to-market strategy

  • Lead product demonstrations tailored to the context of various law firm practice groups and in-house legal teams, asking questions to validate how Harvey can add value and then showcasing Harvey’s features and benefits relevant to each prospective client’s potential use cases.

  • Act as the “Voice of the Customer,” using your legal perspective to help the broader sales team to develop and implement more effective strategies and synthesize customer feedback for the product team through a legal lens.

  • Travel may be required from time to time, including visits to customer office locations and company offices.


What You Have

Stratégie et pilotage HSE

  • Définir la politique HSE et ses objectifs à court, moyen et long terme, en cohérence avec la stratégie, la réglementation et les référentiels ISO.

data.title: Finance Business Partner
data.description:
About Everfield

Everfield buys, builds, and grows European vertical market and specialist software companies, providing them with the tools they need to move to the next level. Our mission is to foster ambition, fuel growth, and unlock opportunities for Europe's software ecosystem.

Companies in the Everfield ecosystem follow a decentralised model, maintaining their team, brand, and offices, while focusing on what they do best - building products and supporting customers. Everfield provides support in talent acquisition, HR, and access to a team of experts in building and growing European B2B SaaS companies who consult on financial and operational topics. Founded in 2022, Everfield has an ecosystem presence in 9 countries, and growing.

About the Role

This is not a reporting role. It's ownership of the financial engine for a portfolio of growing software businesses.

You'll be accountable end-to-end for the accounting integrity of your portfolio: closing the books accurately, building and leading a team of local finance experts to meet French statutory and regulatory requirements, and making sure every number that reaches Everfield's leadership is right and on time. But the job doesn't stop at accuracy. You'll sit next to Business Unit Leaders as their financial conscience and commercial sparring partner - coaching them on the numbers, challenging their growth plans, and pushing them to allocate resources where they'll actually compound.

Everfield deliberately gives this role more scope than a typical FP&A or controller seat carries at this career stage. You'll run the accounting, build and lead the regional finance team, and shape how each business thinks about growth - the full stack, across multiple companies.

What You'll Do

Own the numbers

• Be accountable for the accuracy and timeliness of monthly reporting (management P&L, KPIs, operating metrics) for each business in your portfolio - not just its preparation.

• Build and manage a team of local financial experts to meet French statutory and regulatory compliance requirements.

• Guide each business's finance and accounting team through migration onto Everfield's NetSuite instance.

• Own the accuracy and timeliness of the underlying accounting work behind every number you report.

• Build and defend annual budgets and rolling forecasts, incorporating strategic initiatives and long-term expectations.

• Prepare Quarterly Update Review (QUR) packs for Everfield's CEO, CFO, and COO.

Drive the growth agenda

• Coach Business Unit Leaders on financial acumen - make sure they understand and consistently apply the Everfield ratios, not just report against them.

• Challenge and support Business Unit Leaders in applying Everfield's prescribed revenue system to their business.

• Help each business spot operating efficiencies, report headcount accurately, and manage overhead with intent.

• Partner with Business Unit Leaders on charting expense management and aligning resources toward growth, not just cost control.

• Play an active role in integration of newly acquired businesses - systems, data, and reporting design, alongside the Integration Director and Head of BI.

• Partner with your Strategic Business Partner (SBP) counterpart on the day-to-day relationship with each business in your region.

Who We're Looking For

• An ambitious problem-solver who wants this role to be a stepping stone – experience on the path towards a CFO or Controller of a larger group of companies, or of a larger standalone business.

• Strong technical grounding in accounting practices and controls - you can run a clean close and hold a third-party provider to a standard, not just review their output.

• Commercial instinct to match: you can sit across from a Business Unit Leader and challenge their growth plan, not just report on whether they hit it.

• A completed university education plus a professional finance qualification (CA/ACA/CIMA or equivalent).

• 5+ years in Business Controlling, FP&A, or Finance Business Partnering.

• Ability to lead and build a team of regional finance specialists.

• Comfort operating in a decentralised, multi-entity, PE-backed environment - you'll manage stakeholders across businesses at very different stages of maturity.

• Fluent in English and French; effective communicator at every level of an organisation, from bookkeeper to CEO.

• Ideally, a background in fast-growing technology or SaaS companies.

• Willingness to travel occasionally.

What We Offer

• Attractive salary package with performance-based bonus.

• Remote flexibility.

• A collaborative team culture based on respect, ownership, and trust.

• Access to international experts within the Everfield ecosystem - accelerate your personal and professional growth.

• Regular team events and company celebrations.

Interview Process

Here's what to expect and who you'll meet during the recruitment process:

• First interview with Talent Acquisition Manager (0.5 h)

• Second interview with Hiring Manager (1.0 h)

• Third interview with Group Finance representatives (1.0 h)

Any hiring decision is made based on skills, qualifications and experiences.

We look forward to receiving your application!

As an Enterprise Account Executive, you'll own the full sales cycle for enterprise accounts, from first conversation through negotiation and close, working alongside sales engineering, customer success, and leadership to get complex deals across the line. data.description:
Here at The Exploration Company, we are building spacecraft for humanity.

As a Cloud Engineer, you will operate and support the cloud platforms that power The Exploration Company’s engineering, operations, and data workloads in France. You will design, deploy, and maintain infrastructure on AWS and SecNumCloud-qualified cloud services so teams can work securely and reliably across both environments. This hands-on, high-ownership role sits at the intersection of aerospace and modern cloud engineering, with a strong focus on security, sovereignty, and compliance requirements.

You will work on-site in France and collaborate closely with engineering teams to translate their needs into resilient, secure, and well-documented infrastructure.

Key Responsibilities

  • Design, deploy, and operate cloud infrastructure on AWS and SecNumCloud-qualified cloud environments, including managed Kubernetes, compute, networking, storage, and managed database services.

  • Define and maintain a consistent architecture across AWS and SecNumCloud, including identity, networking, and secrets management, to keep environments comparable and portable where needed.

  • Build and maintain infrastructure as code (e.g., Terraform) so all environments are reproducible and version-controlled.

  • Implement and maintain CI/CD pipelines that automate infrastructure and application builds, testing, and deployment.

  • Manage container platforms and orchestration, including Kubernetes cluster upgrades, networking, RBAC, and workload scheduling.

  • Set up and maintain observability (metrics, logging, alerting) to detect and resolve issues before they affect engineering or operations.

  • Enforce security and compliance best practices, including IAM policies, network segmentation, encryption at rest and in transit, key management, and vulnerability patching.

  • Support audits and compliance evidence collection for SecNumCloud and other applicable frameworks.

  • Define backup, retention, and disaster recovery strategies for critical data and services.

  • Collaborate with engineering teams to understand their requirements and deliver reliable infrastructure solutions.

What we would love to see from you

  • 3+ years of experience in a cloud infrastructure, DevOps, or platform engineering role.

  • Deep hands-on experience with AWS or GCP, including compute, networking, storage, and managed database services.

  • Solid experience with infrastructure as code (Terraform, Terragrunt) and version control workflows.

  • Experience building and maintaining CI/CD pipelines (GitLab CI, GitHub Actions, or equivalent).

  • Strong understanding of networking concepts: VPCs, subnets, security groups, load balancers, DNS, and VPNs.

  • Working knowledge of containers and orchestration, ideally Kubernetes.

  • Experience with observability tooling such as Prometheus, Grafana, CloudWatch, or OpenTelemetry.

  • Willingness to learn sovereign and high-assurance cloud security requirements, and to apply them to cloud environments. Prior exposure is a plus but not required.

  • A security-first mindset with practical knowledge of IAM, secrets management, encryption, and compliance frameworks.

  • Fluent English. Working knowledge of French is not required but is considered an advantage.

Nice to have

  • Experience in the aerospace, defense, or mission-critical systems domain.

  • Experience with multi-region or disaster recovery architectures.

  • AWS certifications (Solutions Architect, DevOps Engineer - Professional) or equivalent.

data.description:
Here at The Exploration Company, we are building spacecraft for humanity.

Here at The Exploration Company we are developing, producing, and operating Nyx, a modular and reusable orbital space vehicle that aims to eventually be refuellable in orbit - and potentially fly humans in the long run.

data.description:
About Mistral

Mistral provides full-stack AI solutions: from frontier models to developer tools, applications, and compute. We partner with enterprises tackling the hardest problems across high-stakes industries like finance, manufacturing, defense, healthcare, and the public sector, co-creating customized AI systems that they can run on their terms.

Our teams are distributed between Europe, North America, Asia and the Middle East. We are creative, low-ego and team-spirited.

The Role

As a Design Operations Manager (DesignOps), you will sit within Mistral's Product Operations function, with a focus on streamlining the operations of the design team. You will own how the Design team operates as a system — its cadences, its rituals, its coordination, and the connective tissue that lets designers focus on design. This role exists because a design org at our scale needs someone whose full-time job is the operating system itself: defining it, holding it, and continuously tuning it so the team runs with a heartbeat rather than on ad-hoc heroics.

You will own the team's weekly and quarterly cadences — from leadership syncs to planning, retros, and share-outs — and establish how we track work, surface it outward, and make decisions. You'll design the forums where decisions get made and recorded, keep the rituals that create alignment, and aggressively cut the ones that are just overhead.

Equally, you are the bridge across the org. You will coordinate the interlocks between Brand and Marketing for upcoming launches, and between Product and Product Design for the build pipeline — so interdependencies are understood and planned for, not discovered at the last minute. You will partner closely with marketing, PMs, engineering, GTM to align design work with go-to-market timing and surface what's shipping before it ships.

This is a team-of-one role with a founding design-ops mentality. You will build the discipline from scratch, automate repetitive coordination with AI where it helps, and coordinate people where it matters. You report to the Head of Product Operations, working day-to-day with the Head of Design and the design team.

 

What You Will Do

  • Define the operating system of the design team — the cadences, forums, rituals, and source-of-truth that keep the team aligned and moving forward.

  • Own the weekly and quarterly cadences, from leadership syncs and critiques to planning, retros, and headcount-cycle inputs.

  • Coordinate the Brand × Marketing and Product × Product Design interlocks so design work is surfaced with enough lead time and dependencies are planned, not discovered late.

  • Establish how the team tracks and shares out work — a single source of truth for status, and the forums where design is made legible to the rest of the org.

  • Design and hold decision-making forums so decisions get made, recorded, and not relitigated.

  • Separate ritual from overhead — keep the cadences that create alignment and cut the ones that are just tax.

  • Automate repetitive coordination, reporting, and tracking with AI so the team spends time on design, not admin.

  • Bring the wider Product Operations toolkit to the design team — data and analytics for transparent reporting, structured feedback loops and early-access programmes, and launch coordination that aligns design work with product release cycles and go-to-market timing.

  • Partner with marketing, PMs, engineering and GTM to align design work with go-to-market timing and surface what's shipping.

 

What We're Looking For

  • 6–10 years of experience in design operations, product operations, program management, or a chief-of-staff role within a creative or product organization.

  • A founding design-ops mindset — you've built operational disciplines from scratch, not just maintained inherited ones.

  • Comfortable automating with AI tools to remove repetitive overhead, while equally skilled at coordinating people and building coalitions without authority.

  • Strong systems thinking — you design repeatable rhythms and processes, not just run meetings.

data.title: IT Reliability Engineer
data.description:
Du möchtest Verantwortung übernehmen, moderne IT-Umgebungen zuverlässig betreiben und den Bereich IT Reliability Engineering aktiv mit aufbauen?

Als IT Reliability Engineer bist du Teil unseres Engineering-Teams und übernimmst die Verantwortung für die Stabilität, Überwachung und kontinuierliche Verbesserung bestehender Kundenumgebungen.

Du sorgst dafür, dass Systeme zuverlässig betrieben werden, technische Risiken frühzeitig erkannt werden und Monitoring-, Backup-, Update- sowie Lifecycle-Prozesse nachhaltig funktionieren. Dabei leistest du einen wichtigen Beitrag zur Servicequalität und zur langfristigen Stabilität unserer Kundenumgebungen.

Die Themen Monitoring, Betriebsstabilität, Lifecycle-Management und technische Qualitätsstandards haben bei MDigital bereits heute einen hohen Stellenwert und werden aktiv durch unser Engineering-Team gelebt. Aufgrund des Unternehmenswachstums und der zunehmenden Bedeutung dieser Aufgaben investieren wir nun gezielt in eine spezialisierte Rolle innerhalb des Engineering-Teams.

Da diese Position neu geschaffen wird, hast du die Möglichkeit, die zukünftige Ausgestaltung der Rolle aktiv mitzuprägen. Mit dem weiteren Wachstum des Unternehmens besteht zudem die Perspektive, den Bereich IT Reliability Engineering langfristig weiter auszubauen und zusätzliche Mitarbeitende in diesem Umfeld zu etablieren.

Aufgaben

Monitoring & Infrastruktur

  • Überwachung sämtlicher Kundensysteme über unsere Monitoring-Plattformen
  • Analyse, Priorisierung und Nachverfolgung von Warnmeldungen
  • Sicherstellung der vollständigen Integration produktiver Systeme ins Monitoring
  • Überwachung von Verfügbarkeit, Diensten, Hardware- und Storage-Zuständen
  • Frühzeitige Erkennung technischer und sicherheitsrelevanter Risiken
  • Eskalation kritischer Ereignisse
  • Kontinuierliche Verbesserung und Weiterentwicklung bestehender Monitoring-Prozesse
  • Identifikation und Umsetzung von Verbesserungen zur Erhöhung der Betriebsstabilität
  • Förderung von Standardisierung und Automatisierung im täglichen Betrieb
  • Analyse wiederkehrender Incidents und Erarbeitung nachhaltiger Lösungen

Backup & Recovery

  • Sicherstellung funktionierender Backup- und Recovery-Prozesse
  • Nachverfolgung fehlerhafter Sicherungen
  • Integration neuer Systeme in bestehende Backup-Konzepte
  • Planung, Durchführung und Dokumentation regelmässiger Restore-Tests

Client-, Server- & Update-Management

  • Überwachung des Update- und Sicherheitsstatus von Clients und Servern
  • Sicherstellung aktueller Sicherheits- und Systemstände
  • Standardisierung und Automatisierung von Update-Prozessen
  • Verwaltung von Serversystemen über Microsoft Azure Arc
  • Verwaltung von Clients über Microsoft Intune und bestehende Endpoint-Management-Lösungen
  • Förderung einer möglichst zentralisierten und automatisierten Systemverwaltung

Evergreen & Lifecycle Management

  • Überwachung von EOL- und EOS-Systemen
  • Kontrolle von Firmware-, Software- und Security-Ständen
  • Identifikation technischer und sicherheitsrelevanter Altlasten
  • Erarbeitung von Handlungsempfehlungen für Engineering und Management
  • Unterstützung von Standardisierungsinitiativen

Lizenz-, Zertifikats- & Vertragsüberwachung

  • Überwachung von SSL-Zertifikaten und Laufzeiten
  • Kontrolle von Softwarelizenzen und Wartungsverträgen
  • Frühzeitige Meldung bevorstehender Verlängerungen
  • Vermeidung betrieblicher Risiken durch ablaufende Lizenzen oder Zertifikate
  • Nachvollziehbare Dokumentation relevanter Informationen

Dokumentation & Betriebsqualität

  • Pflege und Weiterentwicklung technischer Kundendokumentationen
  • Erstellung und Aktualisierung von Betriebsanleitungen
  • Dokumentation neuer Systeme und Änderungen
  • Sicherstellung eines nachvollziehbaren und professionellen Betriebsstandards
  • Unterstützung bei der Kommunikation kritischer technischer Ereignisse

Pikettdienst und Team-Integration

Als Teil unseres Engineering-Teams beteiligst du dich am rotierenden Pikettdienst und hilfst mit, den stabilen Betrieb unserer Kundenumgebungen auch ausserhalb der regulären Arbeitszeiten sicherzustellen. Die Teilnahme am Pikettdienst wird entsprechend geplant und vergütet.

Bei Bedarf unterstützt du zusätzlich das Engineering-Team bei Rollouts, technischen Umsetzungen oder klar definierten Projektaufgaben was zusätzliche Abwechslung mit sich bringt. Der Schwerpunkt bleibt jedoch bewusst auf der Sicherstellung eines professionellen Betriebs unserer Kundenumgebungen ausgerichtet.

Qualifikation

  • Du übernimmst gerne Verantwortung und möchtest aktiv etwas aufbauen und mitgestalten.
  • Du arbeitest strukturiert, zuverlässig und nachhaltig.
  • Du erkennst Risiken frühzeitig und kommunizierst diese verständlich.
  • Du hast Freude daran, Systeme stabil und sicher zu betreiben.
  • Du interessierst dich für Monitoring, Automatisierung und Prozessverbesserungen.
  • Du schätzt klare Standards und professionelle Betriebsprozesse.
  • Du arbeitest gerne selbstständig und denkst unternehmerisch.

Fachliche Qualifikationen

  • Erfahrung im Bereich System Engineering, IT-Betrieb, Managed Services, Monitoring oder Infrastruktur
  • Gute Kenntnisse in Microsoft 365, Microsoft Azure, Windows Server und Netzwerktechnologien
  • Grundlegendes Verständnis von IT-Security und Cyber-Risiken
  • Erfahrung mit Monitoring-Lösungen von Vorteil
  • Kenntnisse im Bereich Backup- und Recovery-Lösungen
  • Erfahrung mit Microsoft Intune oder vergleichbaren Endpoint-Management-Lösungen
  • Kenntnisse von Microsoft Azure Arc von Vorteil
  • Strukturierte, selbstständige und verantwortungsbewusste Arbeitsweise

  • Führerausweis Kategorie B

Zertifizierungen

Folgende Zertifizierungen sind vorhanden oder deren Erreichung wird gemeinsam vereinbart. Die Zertifizierungskosten werden durch uns übernommen.

  • Microsoft Azure Fundamentals (AZ-900)
  • Microsoft Azure Administrator (AZ-104)

Von Vorteil

  • Sophos Central Endpoint and Server Protection

  • Weitere Microsoft-, Sophos- oder Security-Zertifizierungen

Benefits

Aufbau eines neuen Fachbereichs

Du übernimmst nicht einfach eine bestehende Rolle, sondern gestaltest den Bereich IT Reliability Engineering bei MDigital aktiv mit. Deine Ideen, Erfahrungen und Verbesserungen fliessen direkt in die Weiterentwicklung von Prozessen, Standards und Arbeitsweisen ein.

Hohe Eigenverantwortung

Du erhältst ein hohes Mass an Vertrauen, Verantwortung und Gestaltungsspielraum und übernimmst eine zentrale Rolle für die Stabilität und Qualität unserer Kundenumgebungen.

Moderne Technologien

Arbeite mit Microsoft Azure, Azure Arc, Microsoft Intune, Site24x7, Sophos, Veeam und weiteren modernen Plattformen.

Weiterbildung & Zertifizierungen

Wir fördern deine fachliche und persönliche Weiterentwicklung durch Schulungen, Zertifizierungen und praxisnahe Weiterbildungsmöglichkeiten.

Entwicklungsperspektiven

Mit dem Wachstum des Unternehmens besteht die Möglichkeit, den Bereich IT Reliability Engineering weiter auszubauen und künftig zusätzliche Mitarbeitende fachlich zu begleiten oder ein eigenes Team mit aufzubauen.

Für Kundentermine und Projekteinsätze stehen Dir Firmenfahrzeuge zur geschäftlichen Nutzung zur Verfügung. Du arbeitest dort, wo Resultate entstehen – im direkten Austausch mit den Kunden.

data.title: Senior Solutions Engineer | Switzerland | Remote
Senior AI Engineer - VLA Foundation Model
data.description:
RIVR, part of Amazon is a robotics company pioneering Physical AI through real-world doorstep delivery. Founded in 2024 as an ETH Zurich spin-off, RIVR developed wheeled-legged robots designed to operate in complex, unstructured environments such as stairs, gates, doors, and uneven urban terrain. We believe that achieving general physical intelligence requires solving real customer problems in the real world, where robots can learn from rich operational data at scale.

Following our acquisition by Amazon in March 2026, we are continuing this mission with greater reach and speed. By combining custom robot hardware, onboard autonomy, and cloud-based coordination, RIVR, part of Amazon is building the next generation of safe, reliable autonomous robots for last-mile delivery


Job Description
 
Our fleet of delivery robots operates globally today, generating vast amounts of robotic real-world data. By utilizing state-of-the-art Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models, large-scale generalist models (like Transformers), generative AI, and similar methods, we can leverage this pool of data to significantly enhance its autonomy, navigation, and manipulation skills. In this role, you will develop multi-modal models that enable robots to autonomously generate actions from demonstrations, real-time sensor data, and natural language commands. We are seeking an expert in VLA models, imitation learning, and generative AI techniques with a deep knowledge of supervised, and self-supervised learning algorithms. If you are passionate about pushing the boundaries of AI we invite you to join us in shaping the future of intelligent robotics.
 
 

What you’ll be doing
  • Develop and implement cutting-edge Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models, generalist robot transformers, and imitation learning algorithms (e.g., diffusion policies) to enable robots to autonomously execute complex tasks.
  • Design, test, and refine your algorithms to meet the demands of complex real-world autonomy and navigation tasks, with a focus on spatial reasoning and generalization.
  • Streamline the data collection and training workflow to efficiently expand model capabilities with new tasks and data sources.
  • Collaborate with the reinforcement learning team to innovate methods that leverage both simulated and real-world data.
  • Optimize and distill networks for real-time deployment on the edge (e.g. Nvidia Jetson Thor).
  • Build, lead and mentor an exceptional team of software engineers.
  • Provide expert guidance to product managers and executives for strategic decision-making.
  • Create and maintain documentation, guidelines, and best practices to streamline knowledge sharing.

    • What you must have
  • Master’s degree or higher in a relevant field such as Engineering, Robotics, or Machine Learning.
  • A minimum of three years of industry or research experience, with PhD experience applicable.
  • Strong deep learning fundamentals including supervised learning, self-supervised learning, Transformer-based architectures, policy optimization algorithms, imitation learning, and generative AI techniques (including Diffusion Models).
  • Proven experience in developing Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models or large-scale generalist robot models (e.g., RT-2, Octo, etc.).
  • Strong background in robotics including autonomy, navigation.
  • Experience with deploying artificial neural networks on hardware platforms.
  • Ability to prototype algorithms and train deep neural networks in Python (Pytorch)

    • Get some bonus points
  • PhD degree in Robotics, Engineering, Computer Science, Machine Learning or a similar discipline, or an equivalent amount of research experience.
  • Publications at top-tier conferences.
  • Experience in managing a software team.
  • Ability to write production-level code in modern C++
    • RIVR, part of Amazon is committed to building a diverse and inclusive team that values every perspective. If you’re passionate about driving innovation in robotics and creating meaningful impact, we encourage you to apply and bring your unique self to our team.
     
    We believe the best work is done when collaborating and therefore require in-person presence in our office locations.

data.title: Senior Technical Sales Manager - AI-Driven Software Engineering
data.description:
About CREATEQ

CREATEQ is a Swiss software engineering company with more than 30 years of experience in delivering custom software solutions and modernizing complex legacy systems. We work with leading international companies across industries such as banking and fintech, insurance, aviation and transportation, telecommunications, and energy.

We design, build, and run high-quality software solutions, combining strong engineering expertise, modern technologies, AI-enabled approaches, and proven delivery practices. Our teams work across Java, .NET, PHP, mobile, and web development, helping clients modernize their technology landscapes, improve their software capabilities, and build solutions that are reliable, scalable, and ready for the future.

We are fully dedicated to long-term partnerships, working as one organization with our customers and taking ownership from the first idea through to reliable execution and smooth operation. With nearshore delivery centers across Europe, we bring together experienced engineering and delivery teams who combine technical excellence, business understanding, and a strong sense of ownership.

People, engineering excellence, and strong client relationships are at the heart of what we do.

 

The opportunity

We are looking for an experienced, entrepreneurial Senior Technical Sales Manager to drive new business for CREATEQ with full revenue responsibility. In this role, you will win new clients, shape their entry into AI-driven software engineering, and turn it into long-term engineering engagements delivered by our teams.

Many companies still develop software the traditional way, mostly on Java and .NET. They want to benefit from AI-driven development but lack the know-how, processes, and capacity to do so. This is where you come in: you understand the client's starting point, develop the right approach together with them – from assessment and proof of concept to dedicated nearshore teams – and close the deal.

You will work closely with management, Business Development, and our engineering leads, and you will be the face of CREATEQ to CIOs, CTOs, and Heads of Engineering in Switzerland [and the DACH region].

 

What you'll do

  • Build and close your own pipeline with mid-sized and large companies in Switzerland [and the DACH region].
  • Assess clients' development processes, technology stacks, and AI maturity, and run workshops with engineering teams, IT leadership, and executive management.
  • Develop solution concepts and proposals – from assessment and proof of concept to dedicated nearshore engineering teams.
  • Lead commercial negotiations through to contract signature.
  • Grow existing client relationships and secure follow-on business.
  • Work closely with our engineering leads on team set-up, project kick-off, and quality assurance.
  • Track pipeline, order intake, and revenue against agreed targets and report on progress to management.

 

What we're looking for

This is a senior role with clear revenue responsibility. We are looking for someone who has successfully sold IT services before, brings a strong network in the Swiss market, and is equally credible in conversations with developers and with executive management.

Requirements

  • At least 8 years of experience selling IT services, software engineering, or nearshore/offshore capacity, including several years with personal revenue responsibility.
  • A proven track record in acquiring new clients and closing multi-year service engagements.
  • A strong network among CIOs, CTOs, and Heads of Engineering in the Swiss market.
  • A technical background (computer science, business informatics, or equivalent practical experience) with a solid understanding of Java and/or .NET environments and modern engineering practices (CI/CD, automated testing, DevOps).
  • A solid understanding of AI-driven software development (AI coding assistants, agentic development tools) and a realistic view of its benefits and limitations.
  • An entrepreneurial, closing-oriented mindset and the ability to work independently.
  • Native/Fluent German and excellent written and spoken English.
  • Swiss or EU citizenship, or a valid Swiss work permit.

Benefits

  • A key role with direct impact on CREATEQ's growth.
  • An offering that is high on clients' agendas: AI-driven software engineering, delivered by experienced engineering teams.
  • A compensation package with a fixed salary and a performance-based component.
  • Direct collaboration with management and short decision paths.
  • Freedom to shape the role, bring your ideas, and make a visible impact.
  • A long-term perspective in an international software engineering company with a strong presence in the European market.

data.title: Communications Officer
data.description:
About the BIIE

The Botnar Institute of Immune Engineering (BIIE) is an independent Swiss research institute advancing immune engineering to improve the health of children and adolescents, especially in low- and middle-income countries. The Institute brings together expertise across immunology, bioengineering, computational biology and artificial intelligence, combining fundamental research with a focus on translating scientific discoveries into practical and accessible health solutions. Established through the initiative of Fondation Botnar, the BIIE is a young and growing international research institute based in the Basel region.

Position Overview

We are seeking a creative, proactive and versatile Communications Officer to help bring the research, people and mission of the BIIE to a wide range of audiences.

Reporting to the Head of Communications & Institute Relations, and working closely with scientific and administrative colleagues across the institute, you will help translate complex scientific topics and lead the planning and execution of a broad range of communications activities.

This is a hands-on role, covering digital communications, content creation, internal communications, events and the production of institutional materials. You will take responsibility for content management on the BIIE's website and the Institute’s LinkedIn channel, and the organisation of internal and external events.

Key Responsibilities

Content Creation

  • Develop, write, edit and design engaging content for different audiences and channels, including news articles, press releases, newsletters, presentations, flyers and institutional materials.
  • Work with scientists and colleagues across the Institute as well as partner organisations to identify compelling stories and translate complex scientific topics into clear, accessible content.
  • Coordinate the production of visual and multimedia content, including photography, video and graphics.

Website & Social Media

  • Further develop and manage the day-to-day content of the BIIE website, ensuring it remains accurate, engaging and up to date.
  • Plan and coordinate digital content through an editorial calendar, proactively identifying opportunities for storytelling.
  • Monitor digital performance and identify opportunities for improvement.

Internal Communications

  • Develop and maintain effective internal communications channels to keep employees informed, connected and engaged.
  • Create and coordinate internal news, announcements and other communications materials.
  • Support all-staff meetings and other internal activities that strengthen the BIIE community and foster a shared institutional identity.

Stakeholder Engagement & Events

  • Support media relations activities, including media enquiries, press materials, media lists and monitoring.
  • Support stakeholder engagement activities, coordinating visits and meetings, and maintaining institutional contacts in a dedicated CRM.
  • Plan and coordinate internal and external BIIE events, including scientific events, stakeholder events, visits and institutional activities.
  • Manage event logistics and communications, including invitations, programmes, briefings, promotional materials and follow-up activities.

Communications Strategy & General Support

  • Support the Head of Communications & Institute Relations in establishing and implementing the BIIE's Communications and Institute relation Strategy and related priorities.
  • Ensure consistent application of the BIIE's key messages, tone of voice and visual identity across communications activities and materials.
  • Support the planning, coordination and implementation of communications projects and campaigns across the Institute.

Required Qualifications

Essential

  • University degree in communications, journalism, or a related field.
  • At least 3–5 years of relevant professional experience in communications, science communication, journalism or a related role.
  • Excellent writing and editing skills in English and German.
  • Experience creating and managing content in particular for digital channels.
  • Ability to understand complex scientific topics and translate them into accurate, accessible and engaging content for wider audiences.
  • Strong organisational and project management skills.
  • Ability and confidence to work directly with leading scientists and subject-matter experts.
  • A proactive, collaborative and hands-on working style, with strong attention to detail.
  • Ability to manage multiple priorities in a dynamic and growing organisation.

Preferred

  • Background or professional experience in academia, life sciences, pharma, biotechnology, global health or another field relevant to the BIIE.
  • Experience with website content management systems and digital analytics.
  • Experience with visual communications and design tools such as Adobe Creative Cloud or Canva.
  • Experience producing or commissioning photography, video or other multimedia content.
  • Additional languages apart from English and German.
  • Experience working in an international and multicultural environment.

data.description:
Als projectleider gebiedsontwikkeling bij Waalpartners speel je een cruciale rol in het realiseren van de nieuwbouwopgaven van onze opdrachtgevers. Jij bewaart het overzicht, staat naast de opdrachtgever en draagt bij aan oplossingen voor de uitdagingen die woningbouw met zich meebrengt. Zo hebben we recentelijk meegedacht voor de nieuwe woonomgeving ‘Vlijweide’ in Dordrecht. Bij deze locatie ontwikkeling komt nogal wat bij elkaar. Water, bodem, ecologie, een primaire waterkering én verschillende partijen met ieder hun eigen verantwoordelijkheid en expertise. En dat alles om een toekomstbestendig nieuw woongebied te ontwikkelen.

Dit ga je doen

Met je brede kennis en jarenlange ervaring sta je stevig in een dynamische projectomgeving. Zowel in de voorbereidende als de uitvoerende fase zorg je ervoor dat het proces vloeiend blijft verlopen, ook bij langdurige integrale projecten. Je eigen netwerk zet je in om de dienstverlening van Waalpartners verder te profileren. Als projectleider ben je bovendien de spil in de ontwikkeling van zowel medewerkers als de organisatie.

Dat doe je niet alleen: samen schop je ‘t verder. Je werkt nauw samen met het management en de overige projectleiders over offertes, de bureauplanning en kansen in de markt.

Dit ben jij

Je bent open, nieuwsgierig en staat als leidinggevende stevig in je schoenen. Je omgeving ziet je als collegiaal en je neemt verantwoordelijkheid over je project en de ontwikkeling van de projectteamleden.

Dit bieden wij jou

  • Een salaris tussen €4.500 – €6.900 bruto o.b.v. fulltime dienstverband, afhankelijk van je kennis en ervaring.

  • Groeipad. Met onze Waalacademy bouw je stevig aan je eigen ontwikkeling.

  • Flexibele werktijden. Kom je liever om half 8 binnen, in plaats van half 9? Geen probleem.

  • Hybride werken. We zien je graag op kantoor, omdat we veel met elkaar en onze opdrachtgevers overleggen en samenwerken. Natuurlijk is er ook ruimte om thuis te werken, daarom mag je 2 dagen per week vanuit huis werken (o.b.v. fulltime dienstverband).

  • 27 vakantiedagen

  • Resultaatafhankelijke winstdeling. Draaien we samen een goed jaar? Dan profiteer jij daar ook van!

  • Een goede pensioenregeling onder het oude pensioenstelsel.

  • Een elektrische auto van de zaak, die je ook privé mag gebruiken

  • Plezier. We werken niet alleen aan de ontwikkeling van onze omgeving en onszelf, maar hebben ‘t ook leuk met elkaar. Onze personeelsvereniging organiseert regelmatig activiteiten, we gaan samen op citytrip of een paar kilometer hardlopen.

Dit breng jij mee

  • Je hebt de drive om een project voor alle belanghebbenden tot een goed einde te brengen.

data.description:
We are looking for an experienced Senior Integration Software Engineer to bring our algorithms and software backend together into reliable, operational solutions, and to take technical ownership of how our software is integrated.

Optics11 is a deep-tech company developing advanced fiber-optic sensing technologies for challenging environments and applications in energy and underwater security. Our systems enable high-performance sensing and monitoring through advanced photonics, signal processing, and data-driven intelligence.

We are expanding our R&D team with an Integration Software Engineer who enjoys building clean, reliable interfaces between components and working where software meets hardware, and who takes ownership of making complex systems work together end to end.

As a Senior Integration Software Engineer, you will support their integration into operational systems: connecting algorithms to the backend through robust APIs, building data connectors, health reporting and control software, and defining and verifying integrations with Command and Control (C2) systems.

You will work closely with domain experts in acoustics, signal processing and machine learning, and with the software engineering team, and hands-on with our monitoring systems at our headquarters and production facility. You will also take technical ownership of work delivered by internal and external engineers and set the standard for good engineering practices.

Key Responsibilities

  • Lead software integration engineering for our underwater acoustic sensing systems, ensuring frontend and backend components, algorithms, and hardware systems work together reliably.

  • Integrate the algorithmic toolbox with our system backends, turning research code into maintainable, versioned and deployable software components.

  • Implement data interfaces for our real-time sonar processing pipeline, to ingest multiple sensors (acoustic, heading, temperature, pressure, etc.) from internal and external data acquisition systems. Implement health reporting, logging and monitoring, so that the status and performance of software and system components is visible and actionable.

  • Develop the software control layer for our sensing systems and their hardware components, including APIs for commanding, state handling, error handling and recovery.

  • Implement, align and verify software integrations with external partners and C2 systems, being directly involved in defining interfaces, maintaining interface specifications and running joint integration tests.

  • Testing & debugging: Develop system-level test suites and CI/CD pipelines, diagnose communication failures, and ensure secure, reliable data transfers as the toolbox and backends evolve.

  • Address performance, latency and scalability of the integrated pipeline, together with algorithm and backend developers.

  • Work hands-on with integrated software and hardware systems at our headquarters and production facility, with occasional on-site visits.

  • Review the work of junior engineers and external development partners in depth, promote good practices for packaging, versioning and release, and share integration knowledge across the team.

Why Join Us?

  • Join one of Europe’s most promising deep-tech scale-ups.

  • Shape the future of a rapidly growing multidisciplinary R&D organization.

  • Competitive salary and benefits package.

  • Enjoy regular team activities and company events.

  • Fresh team lunches provided 5 times/week.


Qualifications:

  • BSc or MSc in Computer Science, Software Engineering or a related field.

  • Significant professional experience in software engineering, with a focus on system integration, backend or platform development.

  • Extensive experience developing production software in Python, including packaging, testing, dependency management and writing maintainable, well-structured code.

  • Familiarity with systems programming in C++, or Rust, for the purpose of extending Python for more performance or hardware control.

  • Proven experience designing and implementing APIs and messaging interfaces (e.g. MQTT, WebSocket) and data serialization (e.g. protobuf).

  • Experience with realtime data pipelines, and handling high-throughput or streaming data.

  • Experience with Docker, CI/CD and automated testing in a Linux environment.

  • Experience working with software that interacts with physical systems, and comfort doing hands-on integration and troubleshooting in a lab or production environment.

  • Experience reviewing code and designs, mentoring junior engineers, and setting engineering standards.

  • An outcome-focused mindset, with the ability to own a problem end to end or break it down for others.

  • Ability to work with algorithm developers and translate research code into robust, maintainable software.

  • Flexible and proactive in taking on what needs to be addressed, and comfortable in a fast-paced scale-up environment.

  • Good communication skills in English and the ability to coordinate with internal teams and external partners.

  • Willingness to work primarily from our Amsterdam headquarters, as parts of the role involve classified information and physical systems.

Nice to Have:

  • Knowledge of defense systems or defense standards (e.g. NATO STANAGs, MIL-STD), for example in naval, maritime security or surveillance systems.

  • Experience with the scientific Python stack (e.g. NumPy, SciPy) or integrating signal processing or ML models into production systems.

  • Experience developing software interfaces for controlling instruments or devices.

  • Experience with other messaging or streaming frameworks (e.g. Kafka, ZeroMQ, DDS).

  • Familiarity with observability tooling.

Security & Compliance:

You'll be working with clients in the defense and security sectors, obtaining a Certificate of No Objection issued by the AIVD (Dutch General Intelligence and Security Service) is mandatory. This means you will need to undergo a security screening. For more information, please refer to details on security screening.

Een kerstviering organiseren waar collega's nog lang over napraten? Een externe bijeenkomst tot in de puntjes regelen? Of zorgen dat alles op kantoor lekker loopt?

Bij Zibber krijg je de kans om het allemaal te doen. We zoeken een enthousiaste stagiair Office Management die energie krijgt van organiseren, regelen en dingen voor elkaar krijgen.

Geen stage waarin je alleen maar meekijkt. Hier doe je écht mee!

Over Zibber

Met zo'n 240 collega's in Nederland, België en Duitsland zijn we marktleider in vastgoedmedia. Met fotografie, video en slimme technologie helpen we makelaars om woningen perfect te presenteren.

Op ons hoofdkantoor in Eindhoven werken zo'n 60 collega's samen. De sfeer? Informeel, energiek en altijd in beweging. We werken hard, lachen veel en houden van mensen die initiatief nemen.

De rol

Binnen de stage Office Management werk je nauw samen met onze Executive Assistant en helpt bij alles wat ons kantoor en onze interne projecten nét wat beter maakt.

Denk aan:

  • Het organiseren van Zibber-events, borrels en teamactiviteiten.

  • Het regelen van offsites en externe bijeenkomsten, van locatie tot catering.

  • Zorgen dat alles op kantoor soepel verloopt.

  • Contact met leveranciers en het oppakken van praktische verzoeken.

  • Meewerken aan leuke interne projecten en verbeterideeën.

En zie jij iets dat slimmer, leuker of makkelijker kan? Laat van je horen!

Wat je van ons krijgt

  • Een afwisselende stage waarin je écht iets kunt bijdragen.

  • Ruimte om zelfstandig dingen op te pakken en eigen ideeën uit te voeren.

  • Persoonlijke begeleiding van onze Executive Assistant.

  • De kans om veel te leren over office management, events en projectmatig werken.

  • Een werkplek op ons gezellige hoofdkantoor in Eindhoven.

  • Korte lijnen, enthousiaste collega's en volop Zibber-events, lunches en gezelligheid.

  • Een stagevergoeding van €450,- bruto per maand bij een fulltime stage.

  • Bij een fulltime stage in principe vier dagen meewerken en één dag ruimte voor school.

  • Starten in januari of februari 2027!


Je volgt een mbo 4- of hbo-opleiding en zoekt een meewerkstage.

Verder vinden we vooral belangrijk dat je:

  • Positieve energie meebrengt en graag de handen uit de mouwen steekt.

  • Zelf initiatief neemt en niet afwacht.

  • Makkelijk communiceert en vragen durft te stellen.

  • Houdt van organiseren en overzicht bewaren.

  • Goed Nederlands spreekt en schrijft.

Ervaring? Mooi meegenomen. De juiste instelling? Veel belangrijker!

Klinkt dit als jouw stage?

Ben jij iemand die liever zegt 'Ik regel het!' dan 'Wie gaat dat doen?'?

Dan pas je waarschijnlijk perfect bij Zibber. Solliciteer en laat ons weten waarom jij graag dingen voor elkaar krijgt. We maken graag kennis met je!

data.title: Senior Medewerker Finance & Accounting
data.description:
Krijg jij energie van een financiële administratie die tot in de puntjes klopt? Heb je ruime ervaring met boekhouding en houd je graag overzicht over financiële processen? Bij Normec Foodcare zoeken we een ervaren Senior Medewerker Finance & Accounting die zelfstandig de financiële administratie beheert, afwijkingen signaleert en bijdraagt aan een correcte maand- en jaarafsluiting.

Jouw rol

Als Boekhoudkundig Medewerker ben je verantwoordelijk voor een correcte en tijdige verwerking van de financiële administratie. Je houdt je bezig met debiteuren, crediteuren, cashmanagement en grootboekcontroles. Daarnaast bereid je de maand- en jaarafsluiting voor en werk je nauw samen met de Financial Controller en andere collega's binnen Finance. Je maakt deel uit van een Finance-team van zeven collega's en rapporteert rechtstreeks aan Patricia Pouw, Finance Manager.

Jouw verantwoordelijkheden zijn verder:

  • Debiteuren- en crediteurenbeheer: Je beheert de openstaande posten, verwerkt ontvangsten en inkoopfacturen en onderhoudt contact met klanten en leveranciers over betalingen en factuurverschillen.

  • Cashmanagement: Je verwerkt bankmutaties, bewaakt de geldstromen en bereidt betalingen voor. Ook ondersteun je bij de liquiditeitsplanning.

  • Voorbereiden van de maand- en jaarafsluiting: Je zorgt dat de administratie volledig en tijdig is bijgewerkt. Je bereidt boekingen, reserveringen en balansspecificaties voor en ondersteunt bij de jaarafsluiting en accountantscontrole.

  • Grootboek en financiële controles: Je controleert grootboekrekeningen en financiële aansluitingen, onderzoekt afwijkingen en bereidt correcties voor.

  • Aanvullende administratie: Je houdt je bezig met intercompany-afstemmingen, vaste activa en de voorbereiding van btw-aangiften.

  • Procesverbetering: Je signaleert knelpunten, doet verbetervoorstellen en helpt de kwaliteit en efficiëntie van de financiële administratie verder te verbeteren.

Daarnaast ben je een inhoudelijk aanspreekpunt voor collega's bij complexere boekhoudkundige vraagstukken en ondersteun je hen met jouw kennis en ervaring.

Ons aanbod

Een afwisselende functie bij Normec Foodcare, met ruimte om zelfstandig te werken, mee te denken en jezelf verder te ontwikkelen. Je komt terecht in een betrokken team waarin samenwerking centraal staat. Wat je verder mag verwachten:

  • Een jaarcontract met uitzicht op een vast dienstverband

  • Een salaris tussen € 4.000 en € 4.500 bruto per maand op basis van een fulltime dienstverband, afhankelijk van jouw ervaring

  • Een dienstverband van bij voorkeur 40 uur per week. Een dienstverband van 32 uur per week is ook bespreekbaar

  • Hybride werken en flexibele werktijden: je kunt je werkdag indelen tussen 07.00 en 19.00 uur

  • 25 vakantiedagen en 8% vakantietoeslag

  • De mogelijkheid om extra vakantiedagen te kopen

  • Een goede pensioenregeling

  • Een reiskostenvergoeding

  • De mogelijkheid om deel te nemen aan het fietsplan

  • Een continu ontwikkelprogramma waarin je wordt gestimuleerd om je talenten verder te ontwikkelen

  • Een collectieve ziektekostenverzekering bij VGZ

  • Een actieve personeelsvereniging die het hele jaar door diverse leuke activiteiten organiseert

Jouw profiel

Je bent een positief kritisch ingestelde en betrokken professional, die graag meedenkt en bouwt aan onze Finance-afdeling.

Daarnaast beschik je over:

  • Mbo+/hbo werk- en denkniveau in een financiële of boekhoudkundige richting

  • Minimaal 3 jaar relevante werkervaring als Boekhouder, Financieel Administratief Medewerker of in een vergelijkbare financiële functie

  • Ruime ervaring met zelfstandig boekhouden, debiteuren- en crediteurenbeheer en het voorbereiden van maandafsluitingen

  • Een goed begrip van grootboekadministratie, balansposten, btw en de samenhang tussen boekingen en financiële rapportages

  • Goede vaardigheden in Excel en ervaring met een ERP-systeem. Kennis van Exact Online of Business Central is een pré

  • Je hebt een goede beheersing van de Engelse taal, zowel mondeling als schriftelijk

  • Een nauwkeurige, gestructureerde en proactieve werkwijze. Je voert niet alleen werkzaamheden uit, maar onderzoekt ook zelfstandig afwijkingen en denkt mee over oplossingen

  • Goede communicatieve vaardigheden en het vermogen om prettig samen te werken met klanten, leveranciers en collega's. Je deelt graag je kennis en ondersteunt anderen waar nodig

  • Je bent bij voorkeur 40 uur per week beschikbaar

Over Normec

Normec Foodlab Ede is onderdeel van Normec, toonaangevend in de Testen, Inspectie, Certificering en Compliance (TICC) industrie. Onze expertise raakt essentiële gebieden zoals water-, lucht- en bodemkwaliteit, brandveiligheid en voedselveiligheid, waarbij we de hoogste normen van kwaliteit en veiligheid garanderen in verschillende sectoren. Normec is opgericht in 2016 en is een ambitieuze, onafhankelijke en snelgroeiende organisatie.

We bieden onze collega’s de kans om actief bij te dragen aan onze missie én tegelijkertijd hun eigen carrière te ontwikkelen binnen een dynamische en snelgroeiende organisatie. Samen werken we aan impactvolle oplossingen voor onze klanten en aan een duurzame toekomst. De cultuur binnen Normec is informeel, open, energiek en ondernemend en is verankerd in onze GROWTH-principes. Middels ons The Normec Fit-programma, waarmee de deze principes tot leven brengen, zorgen we ervoor dat niet alleen ons bedrijf groeit, maar ook iedereen die er deel van uitmaakt.

Interesse? Laten we kennismaken!

Ben je geïnteresseerd in deze vacature? Dan kijken we uit naar jouw sollicitatie! We behandelen jouw gegevens vertrouwelijk en zorgen ervoor dat je binnen vijf werkdagen een reactie van ons ontvangt.  Voor vragen over deze vacature kun je contact opnemen met team Recruitment, via . Zij helpen je graag verder.

De procedure:

  • Eerste telefonische screening en verdere bespreking van de vacature

  • Persoonlijk gesprek bij Normec

  • Referentiecheck (na jouw goedkeuring)/ assessment

  • Tweede gesprek/bespreken arbeidsvoorwaarden bij Normec

  • Gefeliciteerd, je hebt je nieuwe uitdaging gevonden

 Op zoek naar een nieuwe uitdaging binnen de voedingsmiddelenindustrie, maar is deze functie niet helemaal wat je zoekt? Volg Careers at Normec Foodcare op LinkedIn en blijf op de hoogte van al onze vacatures.

Ongevraagde acquisitie door bureaus wordt niet op prijs gesteld en zal niet worden beantwoord.
